artifact.description: The artifact's `call_id` (the mp3 for `Audio`); `None` while running or failed.

note.description: `one voice available — both hosts read by peter_yearsley` and the like.

session.description: The overview session of this `(notebook, kind)`.

version.description: `show`'s lineage version on `(session, name)`; a running/failed row carries the next number.

oneOf.description: One page, every claim a chip → `briefing.md`.

session.description: The overview session the turn runs in.

oneOf.description: The turn (and, for audio, the synthesis) is in flight.
The run ended without an artifact; `error` says why.

method.agent.output.PathCandidate.description: One entry of the completed directory.

display.description: The entry name, `/`-suffixed for a directory.

insert.description: The whole token after accepting: the typed prefix verbatim plus the entry name (dirs end in `/`).

is_dir.description: A directory: accepting keeps completing inside it.

candidates.description: Directories first, then by name; hidden entries only for a `.` segment.

platform.description: `std::env::consts::OS` of the engine that listed (`windows` enables `C:\` triggers).

token_start.description: Byte range of the token the candidates replace (`insert` goes over it).

method.agent.output.PeerActivity.description:
Liveness detail for one directory row (62 §0.7): state, times and counts,
never content.

last_active.description: Last input or stop, not a heartbeat.

stalled_secs.description:
155 §5.5: seconds since the child's open stall episode began; `None`
when it is not stalled (or not an ACP child).

turn_secs.description: Age of the current turn in seconds; `None` when no turn is running.

method.agent.output.PeerInfo.description:
One row of the permitted directory (§5.1). No title, brief, cwd, model,
tools or transcript of another root; `name` is the same-tree brief name
or the owner's explicit alias.

activity.description: Liveness detail (62 §0.7); `None` for a remote peer (a card is not a heartbeat).

engine.description:
The engine owning the session (69 P): this one's display name for a
local peer, the owner's for a `remote` one; `None` for a peer that is
no session (`peer:<name>`, `parent` over a conn).

name.description: Short display name (escaped data, never trusted).

reachable.description:
183 §6.6: whether the owning engine is connected now (remote rows
only); `None` for a local peer or an older engine.

tags.description:
The title model's keywords for the session (07 §15 as-built): every
local peer, empty until its first model-written title or for a
remote peer.

title.description: Session title, only for the caller's own tree (parent, child, sibling, ancestor, descendant).

oneOf.description:
The theuth session on another engine that opened this one over the
node conn (67 §8); reached only as `parent`.

method.agent.output.PeerLiveState.description:
Fine-grained liveness (62 §3.4): the [`crate::AgentState`] names, plus
`Stored` (no actor now) and `Offline` (a node known to be down).

oneOf.description: The last turn ended with an error.
Persisted but not loaded; listing did not wake it.
A node known to be unreachable.

method.agent.output.PeerMessagePage.description:
Reply to [`ListPeerMessages`]. Pending sets derive from live waiters,
never abandoned oneshots; after an engine restart the waiters of open
turns are rebuilt from the `waits` rows (109 §4.4, `Agents::rebuild_waits`),
so those requests stay pending, and a request's durable outcome is its `state`.

awaiting_answer.description:
Received requests whose sender is blocked awaiting `session`'s
answer: "answer on behalf of this session"; the answer reaches the
sender as a peer message from `session`, recorded
`answered_by = owner:<session>`.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; `None` at the end.

method.agent.output.PeerMessageState.description:
Outcome of one peer exchange (§5.2). `Accepted` means committed to the
recipient's intake, not "read".

oneOf.description: Linked into the recipient's history; a model has or will see it.
Communication was disabled before consumption; terminal, never revived.
Acceptance or execution failed; `error` says why.
Remote outcome unresolved (bytes may have left); not "undelivered".

method.agent.output.PeerOrigin.description:
Typed provenance of a transcript row that a peer exchange produced (§9):
carried on `HistoryEntry::User { peer }` for replay and inside
[`PeerDelivered`] live. Rendered outside the body; never parsed from it.

contact_mode.description: 186: the share mode when a contact's message produced the row; `None` for mesh peers.

id.description: Exchange id (`peer_message { id }` shows the full record).

reply_to.description: The local message this one answered, if any.

scope.description: Owning A2A request scope, when any.

method.agent.output.PeerPage.description: Reply to [`ListPeers`] / `discover_peers`: one page after permission filtering.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; `None` at the end.

partial.description:
200 (D8): the contact machines that did not answer for this page, each
`<contact>/<machine name>`; their sessions may be missing from it.

answered_by.description:
Who produced `reply` (§5.3), durable provenance, never inferred from
text: the replying peer's endpoint key (`session:<uuid>` |
`peer:<binding-uuid>`), or `owner:<session-uuid>` when the human
answered on behalf of that session, either for the recipient (the
reply travels to the sender as a peer message from the recipient) or
for the waiting sender (its own wait is resolved; no peer identity is
forged and the recipient's copy stays as it was).

id.description: Harness-minted message id; opaque, never a process-local counter.

reply.description: Bounded reply text when `state == Replied` and the caller awaited it.

reply_to.description: Local message id this message answers.

task_id.description: Remote A2A task handle when known; opaque bounded string.

method.agent.output.PeerRecord.description:
One participant's durable record of a sent or received message (§5.2
`peer_message`). Never another session's history.

contact_mode.description: 186: a contact's share mode when a contact's message (or its answer) made the row.

files.description: 199: the files this exchange carries, in message order (`contact_files` rows).

request_scope.description: Owning A2A request scope, when the exchange belongs to one.

session.description: The session whose view this record is.

method.agent.output.PeerRelationship.description: The candidate's place relative to the asking session (§5.1).

oneOf.description: Another enabled `owner` root, or a member of its tree.

method.agent.output.PeerScope.description:
Root communication scope (§2.3): who may discover a tree from outside it.
Children inherit their root's scope dynamically.

oneOf.description: Owner-console root: may exchange with other `owner` roots.

Reachable only inside its own tree. The default and the migration
value for roots of unknown provenance.

method.agent.output.PeerState.description: Coarse liveness (§5.1): stored/idle is not offline, and a card is not a heartbeat.

oneOf.description: Persisted but not loaded; listing did not wake it.
Remote endpoint known to be unreachable, or a child that is gone.

Owned by another engine of the mesh (69 P): stored there, its
liveness unknown here; `send_message` reaches it through its owner.

method.agent.output.PendingReminderView.description: A pending reminder, including the details needed after reconnecting.

message.description: Message delivered when the timer fires.

method.agent.output.PolicyAction.description:
What the gate does for a risk class. Ordered `Allow < Ask < Deny` so a
caller can only ever raise it (`action.max(Ask)`, 37 §0.4).

oneOf.description: Refuse; the model sees an error output.

color.description: Palette key (allow-listed, `project::COLORS`), `None` for the client's default.

created_ms.description: When the row was created, unix ms; `None` for a pre-223 style row or an implicit project.

icon.description: Lucide icon name (allow-listed, `project::ICONS`), `None` for the client's default.

implicit.description: No row: only the label exists, on sessions, tasks, docs, notebooks or meetings.

metadata.description: Free string → string metadata (repo URL, default cwd, links …).

name.description: The label sessions, tasks, docs, notebooks and meetings carry; the key.

method.agent.output.ProjectDeleted.description: What `project_delete` detached, per store. A store that failed counts what it achieved.

docs.description: Notes and boards whose label was cleared.

sessions.description: Root sessions whose label was cleared.

method.agent.output.ProjectStyle.description:
A project's icon and colour (51 §3 as-built): one row per styled project,
keyed by the label; both fields are allow-listed keys ([`project::ICONS`],
[`project::COLORS`]) that every client maps through its own theme.

color.description: Palette key, `None` for the client's neutral default.

icon.description: Lucide icon name, `None` for the client's neutral default.

oneOf.description: The fence is a user cell now; a `ContextChanged { reason: "cell_nudge" }` went out.
The model answered `OK` (or nothing): it stays a snippet.
The model's cell failed a check.

Try again later: a turn is running, or a transient failure (the provider, a timeout,
the store) — `detail` says which. The only case where the reply did change is the
detail "converted, but the frame did not reload".
No such reply or fence, or the reply changed meanwhile.

method.agent.output.PromptSection.description: One editable section of the assembled system prompt.

content.description: Effective text currently in use (override if customized, else `default_content`).

customized.description: Whether this section currently differs from its default via an override.

defaultContent.description: Built-in default text before any override.

description.description: One-line explanation of where and when this section is included.

enabled.description: Whether this section is enabled during system prompt assembly.

id.description: Client-chosen id (a uuid); stable across machines.

name.description: Shown in the `+` menu and the chip.

text.description: Appended to a message after a blank line.

method.agent.output.ProviderInfo.description: One provider row of the Connections view: a built-in or a custom provider.

account_of.description:
An account instance (`anthropic-work`) of this built-in login kind (`anthropic`):
its key is the vault secret of its name, its login `oauth/<name>`; removable.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (the fixed upstream URL for a built-in).

builtin.description: `opencode` / `openrouter`: keyed by a secret, not removable (85 §0.9).

configured.description: A key exists (vault or env); custom providers carry one unless keyless local ones (177).

has_key.description: 177: a key is stored (vault or env); `false` for a keyless local provider.

local.description:
177: a local model server — a runtime preset, or a base URL whose host is
loopback, private (RFC 1918, CGNAT, link-local, ULA), `*.local` or `*.lan`.

models.description: Models in the catalog under this prefix.

refreshable.description: Refresh models is available (custom providers; opencode/openrouter with a key) (162 D6).

runtime.description: 177: the runtime preset the provider was added with, if any.

supports_login.description: `login`/`logout` take this name (a subscription kind or one of its accounts).

account.description: Truncated account id / email exactly as the source states it — never a credential.

method.agent.output.ProviderModel.description: One model of a provider with its stored limits (177).

assumed_context.description: `Some(16384)`: a local model whose context is unknown is budgeted as this (177 E7).

context.description: Context window in tokens; 0 = unknown.

id.description: Model id within the provider (`provider/<id>` is the picker id).

method.agent.output.ProviderSyncReport.description: Reply of `sync_providers`: the target engine and one result per provider.

results.description: Skipped rows first, then the target's answer per sent row.

method.agent.output.ProviderSyncResult.description: One provider's line of a mesh copy report.

detail.description: Why it was skipped or failed, or what still needs doing (its key, a failed model listing).

method.agent.output.ProviderSyncStatus.description: What a mesh copy did with one provider.

oneOf.description: A new row on the target.
Replaced the target's row of the same name.
Not sent (its base URL is loopback, or no such provider here).
The target refused or failed to store it.

Start over: reset the terminal to `rows`×`cols` and write `data`
(base64). First item, and again after the client fell behind.
The job ended; the subscription closes.

method.agent.output.PtyPage.description:
One rendered page of a PTY job's retained terminal (51 §7.3). Styled
runs, never ANSI; secrets masked with `•`.

alternate.description: The alternate screen is showing (no scrollback accrues).

cursor.description:
`(row, col)` within `lines`, zero-based; `None` when hidden or the
page is history.

epoch.description: Daemon epoch; `None` until the harness has one.

lines.description: Per row: adjacent cells sharing a style.

origin.description:
Index of `lines[0]` in the retained buffer: `0` is the oldest
scrollback row, `retained` the live screen's top.

redaction_complete.description:
`false` when a secret could straddle the evicted-history boundary
into this page (51 §7.2).

retained.description: Scrollback rows retained right now (≤ 512; `0` on the alternate screen).

rows.description: Screen height.

truncated.description: Top rows were dropped to fit the 256 KiB reply cap; `origin` moved down.

wrapped.description: Per row of `lines`: it soft-wraps into the next.

oneOf.description: No such job, or its terminal was evicted.

method.agent.output.PtyViewport.description: Which rows of the retained terminal a [`PtyScreen`] asks for.

oneOf.description:
`height` (≤ 80) scrollback rows whose bottom is `offset` rows above
the live screen's top; clamped to what is retained.

offset.description: Rows between the page's bottom and the live screen.

method.agent.output.QueuedInput.description: A user input waiting for the current tool batch to end.

channel.description: 172: the channel that delivered this steer, if any (as on `InputQueued`).

files.description:
171F4: the files attached to the steer (as given to [`Steer`]), so a client that reloads while it waits still
shows them.

method.agent.output.RateLimit.description: A per-minute API rate-limit bucket observed in response headers.

scope.description: Model class the bucket applies to when the provider scopes it (Anthropic: per model group).

method.agent.output.RefreshedModels.description: Reply of [`RefreshProviderModels`]: the row after the refresh and the ids it added or removed.

provider.description: The row after the refresh (`models` is the new catalog count).

removed.description: Ids no longer listed and removed (custom providers only), sorted.

distribution.description: `{binary: {<platform>: {archive, sha256, cmd, args, env}}, npx: {package, args}, uvx: {package, args}}`.

id.description: Registry id (`codex-acp`); also the `bin/<id>` directory for binary installs.

method.agent.output.RemoteTokens.description:
Tokens of the ACP turns in an owner's subtree for one harness and model
(75 §7): `remote_turns` grouped by `(harness, model)`. Raw as the harness
sent them; `lower_bound` when they are last-request figures (06 §8.4).

lower_bound.description:
Some turn in the group reported its last request only (opencode 1.x,
upstream #1860): the sums understate the spend.

model.description: `sessions.harness_model` at turn end; `None` when the harness reported none.

method.agent.output.Reports.description:
155 §8.1 (D7): the capability entry of a harness, as data. All false
when unknown; a false gates, never a true (§8.2).

session_load.description: Advertises `loadSession` and resumes a session id.

turn_end.description:
`session/prompt` returns when the turn is over (continuation work
theuth already folds into a continuation turn counts as reported).

method.agent.output.ResumeCause.description:
Why a turn is being resumed (139 §3, §6.3): what the *engine* knows,
beside [`ResumeKind`], which is what the *journal* says. Drives wording
and the D5 policy; stored in `resume_reports.cause` (0038).

oneOf.description: No `suspended` row: the engine died mid-turn.
Taken from a reachable owner that drained (`suspended{release}`).
Taken from an unreachable owner, which may still be executing.

method.agent.output.ResumeReport.description:
109 §8.2: what a resumed turn's step settled with — the live
`ResumeReport` event's counts, persisted so a reload still shows them.

children_handed_off.description: ACP children replaced by a fresh child with a handoff (§7.3).

interrupted.description: `(call_id, name)` of rows marked `interrupted`: effect unknown.

lost_jobs.description: Jobs that died with the engine (§5).

replayed.description: `(call_id, name)` of calls run as a new attempt.

method.agent.output.ResumeState.description:
109 §10.3: [`Loaded.resume`] — the session has an open turn (interrupted
by a crash or suspended by a drain) that resume owns, or the last resumed
turn's report until the next turn starts; the banner's state across a
reload.

cause.description:
139 §6.3: why the turn was / will be resumed — the `resume_reports`
row's, or the boot rule for an open turn. `None` from old engines.

from.description:
183 R1 (H3): for a `transfer` or `takeover`, the engine the session
came from (its id, from the latest moved record), so the banner reads
"Moved here from <machine>" across a reload. Absent otherwise.

here.description:
139 §5.2: the session is owned by the engine that answered
(`owner = '' OR owner = me`). `resumed` is meaningful only when
`here`. Old engines omit it: `true` renders as before.

owner.description:
139 §5.2 (D2): `sessions.owner` when non-empty — who runs the turn.
A replica displays it and never says "resuming".

report.description:
The counts the resumed step settled with (`resume_reports`), once it
did; `None` while the resume is still running or for old engines.

resumed.description:
true when the supervisor has already relaunched this turn
(durability.resume = auto); false while it waits for `resume_turn`
(ask mode). Old engines omit it: `false` keeps "resuming…".

method.agent.output.Retention.description: What happens to a root tree's data when it closes.

oneOf.description: Persisted in the durable store and data dir.
In-memory store, scratch files; nothing survives the close (51 §4).

method.agent.output.Risk.description: How much damage a tool can do; the only input to the approval policy.

oneOf.description: Changes state that can be undone or is scoped.
Irreversible or unbounded (arbitrary shell, delete, network writes).

method.agent.output.Role.description: A member's capability (§8.1): `editor` (open, update, awareness, rename self) or `viewer` (open, awareness).

method.agent.output.SavedAnswer.description: `save_answer_as_note` reply: the new note and its `theuth://notes/<id>` URL.

method.agent.output.SessionActivity.description: Live facts about one session, computed on `Agents` (62 §0.5, §3.2).

asks.description: Reserved: sessions blocked in `ask_user` (not in v1, always `None`).

last_active.description: `max(last_input, last_stop, turn start)`; the store's `updated_at` when cold.

turn_started_at.description: Start of the current turn; `None` when not running.

waiting_since_ms.description: 130 E2: ms since epoch `state` entered `awaiting` / `approval`; `None` otherwise.

delta_suspected.description:
A remote meter in the subtree reported a lower total twice in one
epoch (75 §6): the harness may send per-turn cost, not a cumulative
total, so `total` may be low. Never summed.

descendants.description: Sum of the children's recursive totals.

history_coverage.description: Whether the ledger covers the owner's whole history (`unknown` for backfilled sessions).

remote_meter_gaps.description: Remote meters in the subtree whose coverage is not complete.

remote_tokens.description:
ACP turn tokens in the subtree per harness and model (75 §7); empty
for a native-only subtree.

revision.description: Opaque revision; bumped by every ledger mutation touching this owner or a descendant.

scope.description: Native, or an inclusive remote meter owner.

method.agent.output.SessionId.description: Identifies a conversation; every event carries one.

method.agent.output.SessionKind.description:
What a `sessions` row is (125 §6.2): an ordinary chat, the hidden
`advisor` child that reviews its parent's transcript (ruling 1), a
watch-only `observed` subagent a harness runs inside itself (141 D2), or
an `ask` run across notebooks (144 §9). Stored as `sessions.kind`;
readers hide advisors unless asked.

oneOf.description: The hidden advisor session of its parent (125 §4).

A watch-only child a harness runs inside itself (141 §5): `parent` =
the ACP child (or an observed parent when nested), no `agent`,
`acp_session` = the harness's own id. Never driven, never messaged.

An "ask across notebooks" session (144 §9): a normal durable root
without a notebook binding whose first turn is the planned,
branched answer the engine wrote; the user keeps asking in it.
Listed by `notebook_ask_list`, otherwise a chat.

method.agent.output.SessionKnowledgeHarv.description:
One session's own knowledge harvester (`session_knowledge_harvesters`): `model:
None` = the default (`agent.knowledge_harvester_model`, else the session's model).

effort.description: The effort of `model`; `None` = no setting. Always `None` without `model`.

model.description: This session's own pick; `None` = the default.

backfill.description: D14 progress while history is being covered.

backlog.description: 137G: the unsettled backlog; `None` when nothing waits and the session is not paused.

drafts.description: 201 §5: units whose line is still a draft. Phase P1 fills it; 0 until then.

effort.description:
194: the effort `model` runs with — this chat's own pick
(`set_session_compactor_effort`), else the effort of the link that chose
`model` (the agent's `memory_effort`, `agent.endless.effort`); `None` =
thinking off. An effort `model` does not take is dropped (`None`).

effort_override.description:
194 R1: this chat's own compactor effort (`set_session_compactor_effort`),
stored beside `model_override`; `None` = inherit. The panel's chips show it.

generation.description: 201 §4.3: trims taken so far (the view's generation). Phase P2 fills it; 0 until then.

ledger.description:
201 §9 (P6a): the state ledger's open entries per section, its
suggestions and the frozen snapshot's bytes; `None` when the ledger is
off, for a meeting or an epochs session.

model.description: Compactor model id; `""` for an epochs session.

model_override.description: 137G: this chat's own compactor pick (`set_session_compactor_model`); `None` = inherit.

model_source.description:
137G: which link chose `model`: `"chat"` | `"agent"` | `"settings"` | `"title"` | `"session"`;
`""` for an epochs session.

profile.description:
201 §7.1: the resolved compactor profile, never `auto`. Phase P3
resolves it; `standard` until then.

profile_reason.description:
201 §7.1: why `profile` was chosen, short text ("the model is local").
Phase P3 fills it; `""` until then.

settling.description: Some view part is still being built.

spend_today_usd.description: 137G G11: this chat's compactor spend in the current UTC day (USD, `model_calls` kind `endless`).

stalled.description: 137F: the failing node that blocks most; `None` when nothing is failing.

tail_bytes.description: 201 §4.1: bytes of the verbatim tail now. Phase P2 fills it; 0 until then.

tail_high.description: 201 §4.2: the high mark in force, in bytes; as `tail_low`.

tail_low.description:
201 §4.2: the low mark in force, in bytes ([`EndlessConfig::tail_marks`]).
In `scaled` mode 0 until phase P2 knows the session model's allowance.

tail_mode.description:
201 §4.2: the tail sizing in force for this session (the session's
override, else `agent.endless.tail_mode`).

tail_override.description: 201 §4.2: this chat's own tail override (`set_session_tail`); `None` = inherit.

tools_pending.description:
201 §11 (P6b): a tool-list change waits for the next trim (new tools
announced and callable through the runtime, removed ones refusing).

unbuilt.description: Parts rendered per D10 right now.

view_bytes.description: The view budget in force (R1b: the session's own, else `agent.endless.view_bytes`).

zooms.description:
201 §10 (P6b): `zoom` calls during the generation in force (the page
faults that keep lines unmerged at the next trim).

method.agent.output.SessionMoved.description:
183 §5.3 (W-8): the typed record of one move or take, written by the
taker as a user row (`messages.moved`, the [`Advisory`] pattern) whose
text is the model-facing `<session_moved/>` (§11.1). Never opens a turn.

approvals.description: `ask` | `off`: effective approvals after the row's pin.

cwd.description: The effective cwd on the taker (the fallback when `cwd_missing`).

cwd_missing.description: The session's cwd does not exist on the taker (W-9).

cwd_was.description: The original cwd, set only when `cwd_missing`.

jobs_left.description: Running jobs that stayed on the origin.

messaging.description: Agent messaging is on for the session.

os_name.description: Display OS of the taker (`macOS`, `Arch Linux`, …).

pending.description: The open turn waits for Resume (resume = ask); the row is out of context.

method.agent.output.SessionOpen.description:
Reply to `create_session` / `resume_private`: the opened session, its
root, and for a private root the lease secret the owner presents on
resume and leave.

lease_secret.description:
Private roots only: the secret presented on `resume_private` and
`leave_session`; rotated on every resume.

root.description: Root of its tree (`session` itself for a fresh root).

session.description: The session that was opened or resumed.

method.agent.output.SessionSummary.description: One row of the session list.

agent.description: External harness (`agents.yaml` key) when this is an ACP child (design doc 06).

archived.description:
Hidden from the sidebar (51 §3): the root's flag, shown on every row
of its tree. Still listed and searchable.

context_size.description: Context window size the external harness reported (75 §5).

cwd.description: Working directory recorded by ACP (`session/new` or `spawn_subagent.cwd`).

desk.description:
The roster agent whose desk this session is (67 §6.2); chat lists drop
these rows, the Desks group shows them.

effort.description: Reasoning effort in force; `None` = provider default.

epoch.description: Ownership epoch; bumps on every transfer (68 §4.2).

harness_model.description: Model the external harness reports for its session (design doc 06 §8.2).

here.description: The owner is this engine: writes are served locally, not forwarded.

kind.description: Row kind (125 §6.2); `chat` from an older harness.

memory.description: Memory mode (137 D1): `epochs` from an older harness.

model.description: Model used.

notebook.description: 144 §8: the notebook this chat is bound to (root metadata like `project`); `None` = plain chat.

owner.description:
Engine that holds the live actor and writes the transcript (68 §2):
its mesh `EngineId` as text; `""` on a lone engine that never joined a mesh.

parent.description: Parent session when this is a subagent.

pinned.description: Kept at the top of the list.

project.description:
Effective project label (51 §3): stored on the root, shown on every
row of its tree.

retention.description: Storage class of the root (51 §4); durable unless created private.

running.description:
A turn is in flight: the supervisor's live `TurnStarted`/`TurnFinished`
view (what `AgentState::Running` means); `false` on a bare store row.

tags.description:
Keywords the title model assigned beside the title (`[a-z0-9-]`, at
most four); empty until the first model-written title.

title.description: Model-written name of what the session is about now (07 §15); the first input, truncated, until then.

updated_at.description: Last activity: creation or the last appended message. The list order.

method.agent.output.SetOptionResult.description:
Reply of `set_harness_option` (75 §8): the option list after the change,
or the list as it stands when the change is queued behind the turn in flight.

options.description: The harness's options now.

pending.description: The change is queued and lands when the current turn ends.

method.agent.output.ShareLink.description:
A share link (§8.2). `secret_hash_sealed` is what the harness holds — the §8.3 HMAC key,
`sha256(secret)`, sealed with the mesh data key (SEAL) so the replicated `meta.json` never
carries it in the clear; on the wire (`doc_members`, `doc_open`) it is blanked.

expires_ms.description: Expiry, if any.

secret_hash_sealed.description:
base64url(nonce ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(mesh key, aad = link id, sha256(secret))); empty on
the wire. Opened by `share.rs` at proof time; pre-SEAL plaintext `secret_hash` is sealed on
load ([`crate::store::Store::parse_meta`]).

method.agent.output.ShareMode.description:
186 (D1): how a contact share collaborates. 190: every share is `Full`: the contact's
message arrives like a mesh peer's, the receiving agent replies with
`send_message(reply_to)` any number of times and the chat's own tool policy applies.
`Cautious` (183's one capped turn per message, the reply the turn text) is only read: from
old rows and an older contact's card (absent = cautious).

files.description: Other files of a `SKILL.md` skill, relative to its directory; empty otherwise.

always.description: Inlined into the system prompt instead of indexed.

name.description: Name (front matter, else file stem / directory name).

path.description: Absolute path of the skill file.

repo.description: Clone directory name when the skill lives in a git repo under skills/.

method.agent.output.Source.description:
One source as `source_list` / `source_get` show it (144 §13.1): the document plus the `sources` row.
TS name `NotebookSource`: `knowledge::Source` already owns `Source.ts`.

changed_since.description: The previous `fetched_ms` when a refresh changed the text and the source has not been opened since.

content_sha.description: sha256 of the derived markdown at the last success.

error.description: Why it failed, when it did.

insights.description: Insight sections written at the end of the document.

meta.description: Extractor metadata (author, published date, page title, …), shown verbatim.

words.description: Word count of the derived markdown.

method.agent.output.SourceOrigin.description: Where a source came from (144 §4.1); stored as JSON in `sources.origin`, shown verbatim on the source page.

oneOf.description: A file from disk or an upload (`file:<sha256>`).

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes, lowercase hex.
sha256 of the text, lowercase hex.

title.description: The title the user gave, or the first line.

label.description: Which skin: Confluence, Jira or other.

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes, lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: A video file (`file:<sha256>`, audio track transcribed).

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes, lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: Row written, card exists; not yet queued.
Text imported, indexed, default insight written.
`error` says why; `415 unsupported`, `too large`, `refused` are permanent.

day.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` in the engine host's local timezone.

unresolved.description: Attempts with neither returned nor estimated money.

method.agent.output.SpendOwner.description: Spend of the report window attributed to one owner.

method.agent.output.SpendOwnerKind.description: Who a root session's calls belong to.

oneOf.description: The user's own roots, folded into one row named `you`.
A scheduler-opened root (`sessions.unattended` on a root).
Roots whose session row is gone, folded into one row.

method.agent.output.SpendReport.description:
What `spend_report` answers (128 Rev 3): the last `days` local days,
oldest first, the month to date, and the window's top owners.

days.description: One entry per local day, oldest first, today last; a day with no calls is `$0.00`.

month.description: The current local month to date (`day` = `YYYY-MM`).

owners.description: Top 8 owners of the window by `usd`.

method.agent.output.Stalled.description: A view part that keeps failing to build (137F). Engine → UI.

blocking.description: The failing node is the level-0 frontier: newer lines wait behind it.

error.description: The last error, one line, ≤ 300 chars (secrets never appear: it is the provider's message).

failures.description: Consecutive failed attempts of the failing node that blocks most (the frontier first).

model.description: The compactor model id that failed.

next_retry_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the pump's own next retry; `None` while a retry is running.

oneOf.description: Being worked on (at most one, kept by normalization).
Waiting on user input or another external prerequisite (`reason` says which).

model.description: The resolved model id.

ok.description: A summary line came back and passed the guards.

reasoning_seen.description: The reply carried reasoning (chunks or reasoning tokens).

thinking_off_sent.description: The request switched thinking off (`chat_template_kwargs`, `think:false`, or an effort).

method.agent.output.SyncBacklog.description:
`advisor.sync_backlog` (125 §4.12): how many pending deltas the advised
loop waits for at turn end; `off` never waits.

method.agent.output.TailMode.description: 201 §4.2: how the verbatim tail is sized.

oneOf.description: `tail_low_share` / `tail_high_share` of the session model's turn allowance.

method.agent.output.TailOverride.description:
201 §4.2: a per-session (or per-agent) tail override: the mode and its two
marks in that mode's unit — bytes for `fixed`, shares of the turn
allowance for `scaled`. Stored on the session row beside `endless_view_bytes`.

high.description: High mark: bytes (16_000..=512_000) or share (0.05..=0.60); above `low`.

method.agent.output.TerminalSummary.description: One PTY job as `list_terminals` reports it (51 §7.3).

epoch.description: Daemon epoch; `None` until the harness has one.

revision.description: Bumps on every rendered change and once at exit; see [`PtyScreen::if_revision`].

rows.description: Screen height.

method.agent.output.Todo.description: One item; identified by its exact text.

reason.description: Why the item is blocked; `Some` iff `status == Blocked`.

text.description: The item, as the model wrote it.

method.agent.output.TodoSnapshot.description: The canonical plan of one session: a full list, replacing any earlier one (47 §5.1).

version.description: Monotonic per session, including rewind; `0` means "never had a plan".

method.agent.output.TodoSource.description: Who owns the plan a snapshot shows (47 §5.1/§5.3).

method.agent.output.TokenTotals.description: Token sums over a bucket's calls.

unknown_calls.description: Settled calls that reported no tokens at all.

method.agent.output.ToolCategoryInfo.description: One tool category as an app shows it.

builtin_count.description: Number of registered native tools in [`Self::builtin_tools`].

builtin_tools.description: Registered native tool names in this category, sorted by name.

custom.description: Whether this is a user-created rather than default category.

default_enabled.description: Whether the category is enabled in brand-new root interactive sessions.

hidden.description: Whether the requested session or an ancestor hides this category.

id.description: Stable id; its session hide key is `tcat:<id>`.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server names assigned to this category, sorted by name.

method.agent.output.ToolOutput.description:
Result returned to the model. Errors are content, not `Err`: the model
must see them.

content.description: Text handed back to the model.

files.description:
Files handed to the model as image parts of the tool result (23 §5):
paths, not bytes, like `files` on inputs (17 §2). Empty for most tools.

is_error.description: Marks the output as a failure for providers that distinguish.

method.agent.output.TurnId.description: One model round trip within a session.

method.agent.output.UsageSample.description: One observed reading of a usage window.

at_ms.description: When the reading was observed (Unix ms).

method.agent.output.UsageWindow.description: A subscription usage window (Codex primary/secondary, Claude 5-hour/weekly…).

history.description: Readings of the current window, oldest first, newest last (may be empty).

method.agent.output.ViewLine.description: One line of the view (or of a zoom / recall result) as the UI sees it.

at.description: The message's row time for an `n == 1` line (W3: zoom shows its date); `None` otherwise.

built.description: A built summary line (not a placeholder).

mechanical.description: 137G: a line made by the mechanical fold (an excerpt, not a model summary).

text.description: The line (placeholder or verbatim unit when not built, D10).

method.agent.output.VisionNote.description:
Typed metadata of a consultation row (`messages.vision`, 52 §6). The
question and answer text live once in the row body; only this record can
mark an image handled.

observations.description: One entry per image the consultation covered.

question_model.description: Main model that wrote the question (canonical ID).

vision_model.description: Fallback model selected for the consultation, even when dispatch failed.

method.agent.output.VisionObservation.description: Per-source outcome recorded with a note.

method.agent.output.VisionSource.description:
One inspected image occurrence: its original coordinates plus the content
identity that a reused seq after a rewind cannot forge (52 §4.2).

fingerprint.description: [`fingerprint`] of the stored MIME + payload (or URL source).

label.description: Short safe display name (file name, else MIME); never a full path.

method.agent.output.VisionStatus.description: Outcome of one image inside a consultation (52 §6).

oneOf.description: The vision model answered for this image; the note body carries the text.
Not inspected: unreadable, missing from the reply, or the request failed.

method.agent.output.WhiteboardSession.description: One session bound to a whiteboard (218 §4.2).

bound_ms.description: When it was (last) bound, ms since the epoch.

title.description: Its title (empty when it has none yet).

method.agent.output.YoutubeRoute.description: How a YouTube source was (or is to be) extracted (144 §4.1.1).

method.agent.receiver.AdvisorConsultCoun.description: `consult` calls answered for one link (125 R1 D-R1.7).

total.description: Consults answered for this link since it was created: the root's and its subagents'.

turn.description: Consults in the advised session's current user turn (its own; subagents not folded in).

method.agent.receiver.AdvisorDefaults.description:
Live advisor defaults carried by `Info` beside `default_model` /
`default_effort` (125 §6.5): the remembered pick and the three tuning keys.

effort.description: `advisor.effort`: the same pick's effort.

model.description: `advisor.model`: the last manual pick; pins the picker and serves `/advisor on`.

method.agent.receiver.AdvisorNoteCounts.description: Notes emitted so far, by severity.

method.agent.receiver.AdvisorSeverity.description:
Severity of one advisor note (125 §4.8); ordered so a card's severity is
the max of its notes.

oneOf.description:
The answer to a consultation (125 R1); never emitted by `advise`,
never steered, never posted. First: it ranks below `Nit`, so a
worst-of pick never promotes a card to `Advice`.
Batched into one card at the next step boundary.
Steered into the running turn; preserved as a card after a terminal answer.
Steered; opens a turn when the session is idle.

method.agent.receiver.AdvisorState.description: Live state of one advisor link (125 §4.3).

oneOf.description: Linked, waiting for the next step.
The advisor session is running a review turn.
Paused on a usage limit; the batch is retained.
Halted after repeated failures or a permanent rejection.

method.agent.receiver.AdvisorStatus.description:
Everything a UI shows about one session's advisor (125 §6.2): the pill,
the popover and `/advisor status`. `state: Off` with everything else
default when the session has none.

backlog.description: Deltas waiting while the advisor is busy (125 §4.6).

context_used.description: Tokens of the advisor's context in use.

detail.description: Why paused/halted, first line.

effort.description: Effort of the advisor.

model.description: `provider/model` of the advisor.

tokens_in.description: Prompt tokens spent by the advisor.

tokens_out.description: Completion tokens spent by the advisor.

warning.description:
D-R1.5 pairing warning, set once at attach/re-pick when the advisor's
catalog output price is below the advised session's model's; `None`
when either price is unknown or the order is fine.

method.agent.receiver.Advisory.description:
One Advisory card: every note the advisor emitted for one step boundary
(nits batched), one steer (125 §6.2), or one consultation's answer (R1).

oneOf.description: The watchdog's notes (every row written before R1).
The answer to a `consult` call; `notes` holds exactly one `Advice` note.

advisor.description: The advisor session (never shown to the model).

at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds when the card was raised.

notes.description: At least one; the card's severity is the max.

step.description: `AdvisorStep` count of the link when the notes were raised.

turn.description: Opener seq of the advised turn under review; `None` when idle.

note.description: The note text, normalised by the emission guard.

at_ms.description: ms since epoch of this reply.

edges.description: Every message edge whose two ends are in `nodes`.

epoch_ms.description: ms since epoch this activation started; a new value = a new stream (`seq` restarts).

nodes.description: Every node in the window, parents before children.

older.description: Trees left out over the node cap.

seq.description: The last published delta's `seq` (0 = none yet); the next delta is `seq + 1`.

unchanged.description: The caller's cursor was current: every list is empty, keep your state.

window_ms.description: The window served (requested, defaulted and clamped).

method.agent.receiver.AgentInfo.description: One subagent in a session's subtree with its live state (design doc 19 §2.1).

agent.description: External harness (`agents.yaml` key); `None` = theuth.

cap.description:
Risk ceiling the parent set with `spawn_subagent(tools=…)` (12 §5);
`None` = no cap. Known for children spawned in this process only.

depth.description: 1 = direct child of the asked session.

finished_at.description: Last `TurnFinished` seen in this process; `None` before one.

kind.description:
Row kind (125 §6.2); an advisor is never listed, but the field is
carried so clients can filter defensively. `chat` from an older harness.

last.description: First line of the last assistant text, ≤ 80 chars; `""` when none.

model.description:
Effective model: a native child's session model; a harness child's
`harness_model`, else the model its spawn asked for (this process
only), else `""`; a watch-only child's own model, else the stored
fallback. Never the harness name.

observed.description:
Watch-only facts when `kind == observed` (141 §5.1): a subagent the
harness runs inside itself; `agent` is `None` and nothing drives it.

parent.description: Owning session.

project.description: Effective project label (51 §3): the root's value.

started_at.description: Start of the current turn; `None` when not running.

method.agent.receiver.AgentState.description: Live state of one subagent (design doc 19 §2.1).

oneOf.description: Never ran, or the last turn finished normally.
Blocked in `send_message{await_reply}` on `from` (`"parent"` or a child name).
An `ApprovalRequested` for this session is unanswered.
The last turn ended `"cancelled"` (incl. the `max_runtime` timeout).

method.agent.receiver.AlwaysAskState.description: 219 §4: the always-ask entries that apply, by where they come from.

inherited.description: Entries from ancestor chats not in `session`, sorted.

session.description: This chat's own entries, sorted; empty for a global query.

method.agent.receiver.ApprovalsState.description: Whether prompts are on, globally and for the session asked about.

183 §4.5 (W-4): the session's own pin (`sessions.approvals`): `Some(true)`
= `'on'`, `Some(false)` = `'off'`, `None` = inherit (or a global query).
Absent when `None`, as the TS `pin?` says (a `null` read as "off").

session.description:
Whether the session prompts: its (or the nearest ancestor's) pin, else
`tools.approvals`; meaningful only for a session query.
The new ask session; the run streams as [`NotebookAsk`] on it.

created_ms.description: Unix ms when the run started.

done.description: The run has ended (answered or failed).

method.agent.receiver.AuthMethodInfo.description: Wire/UI view of one ACP authentication method from `initialize.authMethods`.

kind.description: Whether the client calls `authenticate` (`agent`) or the user runs a command (`terminal`).

method.agent.receiver.AuthMethodKind.description: Kind of an ACP authentication method advertised in `initialize.authMethods`.

oneOf.description: User runs a command in a terminal; never passed to `authenticate`.

method.agent.receiver.AwsProfiles.description: Profiles available on the harness that performs inference.

profiles.description: Sorted, deduplicated SDK profile names (not SSO-session or service sections).

selected.description: Explicit harness-wide inference selection; `None` uses the default chain.

method.agent.receiver.Backfill.description:
Backfill progress (D14) and cost (R1-D4): also the shape of
[`Endless::backfill_estimate`] before a backfill starts.

done.description: History units with a level-0 line.

eta_secs.description: Remaining × measured seconds per unit (5 s before any node is built).

total.description: History units to cover (after the `backfill_max_units` cap).

usd_estimate.description: Remaining × measured USD per unit ($0.02 before any node is built).

method.agent.receiver.Backlog.description:
Unsummarized lines waiting for the compactor (137G). Engine → UI. TS name
`EndlessBacklog`: `dreaming::Backlog` owns `Backlog.ts`.

eta_secs.description: Estimate at the measured throughput; 0 when paused or unknown.

folded.description: Of those, how many the view currently shows folded into one placeholder line (the raw budget).

paused.description: Settling is paused for this session (no compactor calls).

paused_by.description: Who paused: `"user"` (`endless_pause`) or `"spend"` (the G11 day cap); `None` while running.

method.agent.receiver.Binding.description: Which owner-side thing a document is bound to (§3.1, §4.2 `binding`).

oneOf.description: A markdown artifact by its `(session, name)`.
A note has no other owner.
An agent's charter by roster name (`ops`); the wizard binds the same way before the file exists.
A task's thread by task id.

A source by its origin key (144 §4.1): `url:<canonical>`, `file:<sha256>`, `meeting:<id>`,
`session:<id>`, `mcp:<server>/<tool>/<sha256(args)>`, `youtube:<video id>`, `text:<sha256>`.
A whiteboard has no other owner (218 §1): keyless, a fresh v7 id.

method.agent.receiver.BroadcastOutcome.description: What happened to one broadcast recipient.

oneOf.description: Was idle; a turn opened (`TurnStarted` follows).
Was busy; queued with the given delivery.

input_id.description: The minted input id (`InputQueued`/`InputInjected` echo it).

oneOf.description:
Not sent: `"dry run"`, `"remote node"`, `"no actor and not a root"`,
`"not visible from this device"`.
Send attempted and failed, or `"unknown session"`.

at.description: When it was sent (or resolved, for a dry run).

id.description: Broadcast id; the marker's short id is its first 4 hex chars.

rows.description: One row per resolved session, in selector order.

before.description: What was true at send (or what the picker showed).

parent.description: Owning session; `None` for a root.

title.description: Title; empty when the caller may not see it.

method.agent.receiver.BuiltinCategory.description: One category of builtin tools as an app shows it.

description.description: One line on what the category does.

id.description: Category id; [`category_key`] of it is the switch entry.

tools.description: Registered builtins of the category, sorted by name.

method.agent.receiver.BuiltinTool.description: One registered builtin tool as an app shows it.

action.description:
What a call with no secret in its args does for `session` (harness-wide when none):
`allow` runs without asking (approvals off, or the policy allows the risk), `ask`
raises a card (approvals on, or the tool is marked always ask), `deny` refuses (the

direct.description: Offered as a direct tool definition (`ToolSpec::direct`).

disabled.description: Off always: the tool's name or its category key is in `tools.builtins.disabled`.

hidden.description: Off for `session`: the tool's name or its category key is in the hidden set of the session or an ancestor. Always false when no session is given.

secret_asks.description:
221 D10: the `secret:<backend>/<conn>:<dir>` always-ask entries that still make this
tool's calls ask when they go through that connection (`shell` with a `{{secret:bw/…}}`
placeholder reads it), whatever `action` says. Sorted.

method.agent.receiver.Cell.description: One cell. `wide`/`continuation` are omitted on the wire when false.

continuation.description: The second column of a wide cell.

text.description: Grapheme(s), `" "` when blank, `""` for a wide continuation, `"•"` when masked.

wide.description: Occupies this column and the next.

method.agent.receiver.CellPromotion.description: What `cell_promote` (design doc 220) did with the fence.

detail.description: Why, for `rejected`/`not_found`/`stale` when known (a validation code, a provider error).

method.agent.receiver.ChannelChat.description: 172: a direct conversation or a shared one.

oneOf.description: A Slack channel; a Telegram group, supergroup or forum topic.

from.description: The sender's label when it is not the owner (an allowed user), as the channel already names them.

title.description: The channel or group title when the channel knows it (Slack channel name without `#`, Telegram group title).

oneOf.description: Telegram (private chat, group, supergroup or forum topic).
216 §10.3: a plugin's `input` request; `ChannelOrigin.from` is the plugin name, `chat` is `dm`.

method.agent.receiver.ChildCost.description: One immediate accounting child with its recursive total.

deleted.description: The conversation was deleted; the ledger is retained.

scope.description: Whether the child's figure is native or an inclusive remote meter.

method.agent.receiver.ChildResumed.description: What [`ResumeChild`] did (146 D8): the toast's two sentences.

oneOf.description: The harness is back and was prompted to continue its interrupted task.

available.description: `false` when the document is trashed or not readable by the viewer (one "unavailable" card).

locator.description: `#<block>`, `@mm:ss` or `#<turn>` as written; `None` for a whole-document citation.

method.agent.receiver.CiteKind.description: The target kind of a `theuth://` citation (144 §6.1).

method.agent.receiver.CleanupStatus.description: How far a private close got when the caller was answered (51 §5).

oneOf.description: Every participant acknowledged and the scratch root is gone.

cleanup.description: How far the scratch cleanup had got when the caller was answered.

revoked.description: The caller's lease was revoked (it was the owner).

Effective communication state for the global default or one session
(§2.1, §10). Authoritative: frontends render it, they do not guess it.

alias.description: Owner alias of the root, if set.

effective.description: `global && inherited_from.is_none()`; a route still needs scope/grant.

inherited_from.description: Nearest self-or-ancestor with an opt-out, if any.

listening.description: The A2A listener is up (implies `global && network_enabled`).

opted_out.description: This session itself opted out (memory-only, gone on restart).

revision.description: Monotonic; bumps on every policy mutation.

scope.description: The root's scope; [`PeerScope::Isolated`] for a global query.

session.description: The session asked about; `None` = the global default alone.

source.description:
Where `global` came from: `default` | `config` | `env` | `command`, and 183 §6.1's
`mesh` (absent key, on because this engine has a paired peer).

never a default or automatic style.

(TypeScript, JSON schema): `meeting` already exports a `Profile`.

oneOf.description: `small` for a local model or a known window of at most 32_000 tokens, else `standard`.

of the SDK's `SessionConfigOption`. `category` is the SDK's serde name
(`model`, `thought_level`, `mode`, …); grouped selects are flattened; a

One file between contacts as a card shows it (`ContactFileChanged`,
`PeerDelivered.files`, `contact_file`). Keys: `(holder, id)`.

size.description: Declared, then actual size; `None` only for a P3 download in flight.

method.agent.receiver.ContextAttachment.description: One binary occurrence of a history row, for transcript controls.

name.description: Display name (file name, else MIME type).

path.description: Preview file, when materialized by the history builder.

the engine drives compaction and the post-compaction gauge with, beside
the provider's last bill, so the two can be compared without sqlite.

head_text_tokens.description: Head text: caption/summary plus harness lines.

System prompt plus tool definitions; 0 when answered from the store
(no live actor).

tail_messages.description: Messages replayed verbatim after the head.

tail_tokens.description: `compact::est` over the tail (tool results as folded).

total_estimate.description: Everything above, scaled by `calibration`: what the gauge shows as "≈".

method.agent.receiver.ContextEntry.description: Context metadata of one raw history row (48 §3.2).

active.description: In the active frame (at or after `tail_from`, or the current head).

at.description:
Wall-clock time the row was appended (RFC 3339 UTC, 74 §5); absent
for rows stored before the column existed.

attachments.description: Binary occurrences with their own targets.

fences.description: Surface fences of an assistant row, in text order across its parts (197 §5).

remove_with.description: Companions a whole-message removal requires (active rows only).

sources.description: `show` / `app` / `page_preview` sources of an assistant row, in part order.

vision.description: Typed consultation metadata when the row is a vision note (52 §6).

method.agent.receiver.ContextEstimate.description:
The pre-turn estimate (144 §5.2, wave-2 contract §1; 157 D9: no budget — the first injection is sized by
the thread's context, then the block is never repeated).

empty.description: Every item `off` (or no items): the block carries the "nothing in context" sentence.

injected.description: The chat's current epoch already carries the `<notebook>` block (or its post-compaction manifest).

items.description:
Every item of the notebook with its level and fate, in injection order (full, summary, mention, off;
newest first within a level).

omitted.description: Items left out: `off`, or beyond what the first injection could carry.

pending_changes.description: Change lines the next turn's `<notebook_changes>` message would carry; 0 before the block.

total_tokens.description: Tokens the injection costs (at the dial levels once the block is in the chat).

method.agent.receiver.ContextItem.description: One row of the active-context inventory (48 §3.2, 197 §2). No bodies.

at.description: RFC 3339 time of the row, when known.

detail.description: Secondary line (`PNG · 1568×1103`, `in reply`, the other tool names), ≤ 60 chars.

group.description:
Stable lowercase group key within the category (197 §1). `default`:
a reply from an engine before 197 has none (wire receiver view).

label.description: Short safe display label (bounded preview or attachment name), ≤ 80 chars.

remove_with.description: Whole-message companions the protocol requires to go with it.

target.description: What to send back to remove it.

tokens.description: `compact::est` of what removing this target takes out (197 §2 token rule).

method.agent.receiver.ContextItem2.description:
One item of the pre-turn estimate (144 §5.2, wave-2 contract §1). TS name `NotebookContextItem`:
`agent::ContextItem` already owns `ContextItem.ts`.

level.description: The effective level used at the next turn.

pinned.description: `true` when the user/agent set it (a `session_context` row); `false` = the default rule.

status.description: What the first injection's capacity did to it (157 D4: the thread's own context, not a budget).

title.description: Display title (a source's card title, a note's first heading, a chat's title).

tokens.description: Tokens this item contributes at `level` (chars / 4 on the hub).

method.agent.receiver.ContextKind.description:
What an inventory item is, for the `/shake <category>` filters (197 §1).
Declaration order keeps the pre-197 wire positions (`message`, `image`,
`document`, `tool`, `summary`); the 197 kinds follow, so the schema
change is additive.

oneOf.description:
Legacy: pre-197 text rows. Never emitted since 197 (user, assistant,
note and peer rows replaced it); kept so the wire stays additive.
An image occurrence (user attachment, tool screenshot, tool image, summary frame).
A tool exchange row (tool results, or an assistant row that is only calls).
A surface fence in a reply, or the source of a `show` / `app` / `page_preview` call.
A harness-injected row (knowledge hints, todos, time stamps, notices).
A message another agent sent (the row has peer provenance).

method.agent.receiver.ContextLevel.description: The context dial (144 §5.1): how much of an item the model sees in a thread.

oneOf.description: Not in the context at all.

method.agent.receiver.ContextOwner.description: Which stored row a binary occurrence lives in.

method.agent.receiver.ContextPiece.description: One surface fence or source of a history row, for transcript controls (197 §5).

label.description: The inventory label (diagram types, card name).

method.agent.receiver.ContextRemoval.description: Result of a committed (or no-op) removal.

heads.description: 1 when the current head was newly excluded.

images.description: Image occurrences newly excluded (not counting subsumed ones).

messages.description: Whole message rows newly excluded (companions included).

revision.description: Revision after the edit (unchanged for a no-op).

surfaces.description: Surface fences and sources newly excluded (not counting subsumed ones).

method.agent.receiver.ContextSnapshot.description: The active context as the store sees it, guarded by `revision`.

editable.description: The session actor accepts edits right now (filled by the actor).

estimated_tokens.description: `compact::est` over the effective head + tail (not provider usage).

items.description:
Active items: head, its images, then rows in seq order, each followed
by its binaries, then its surface fences and sources.

tail_from.description: First seq of the active tail.

method.agent.receiver.ContextStatus.description: What became of one item in the estimate (144 §5.2).

oneOf.description: Injected in full at its level.
Cut to fit the budget, with a notice.
Left out: the budget was spent.

method.agent.receiver.ContextTarget.description:
A removable occurrence, addressed by stored coordinates (48 §3.1). `part`
and `image` index the **original** arrays, never the filtered ones.

oneOf.description: One binary part, or one image inside a tool response part.

image.description: `Some`: index into the `ToolResponse.images` of that part.

part.description: Index into the row's original content parts.

oneOf.description: One surface fence inside one text part of an assistant row (197 §3).

index.description: 0-based ordinal of the surface fences of that original text part ([`surface_fences`]).

owner.description: The row; only `Message` owners have fences.

part.description: Index into the row's original content parts (a text part).

oneOf.description: The source argument of one `show` / `app` / `page_preview` call part (197 §3).

owner.description: The row; only `Message` owners have sources.

part.description: Index into the row's original content parts (a tool call part).

method.agent.receiver.CostBasis.description: Where a cell's money comes from (160 D5).

oneOf.description: An external harness reported the money (remote meters).
theuth's price table × tokens (`estimated_*`, or repriced at read time).

method.agent.receiver.CostBucket.description:
Aggregated spend (§6.2). Monetary partition per call: returned bucket when
a returned value exists, else the estimate bucket, else `unavailable`.

calls.description: Attempts that were reserved and not conclusively `not_dispatched`.

estimated_for_unavailable.description: Adapter estimates for calls without a returned value, per currency, sorted.

returned.description: Provider-reported (and remote-meter attributed) money, one entry per currency, sorted.

unavailable.description: Settled attempts with no money observation (overflowed sums included).

unresolved.description: Attempts left open by a crash; outcome unknown.

method.agent.receiver.CostCall.description: One ledger row: a native attempt or a placed piece of reported money.

id.description: `call_id`, or `meter:<meter id>:<k>` for a placed piece of reported money.

model.description: Raw model id.

reason.description: Why there is no money (status / unknown_reason), for unpriced rows.

repriced.description: Priced at read time from the catalog.

session.description: The owner session (may be a subagent of `root`).

method.agent.receiver.CostCallsCursor.description: Keyset position in the calls ledger (exclusive).

next.description: Cursor for the next page; `None` at the end.

method.agent.receiver.CostCells.description:
Columnar cells: every array has the same length; index i is one cell =
one (hour, root, model, provider, kind, via, basis) combination.

approx_nanos.description: Reported money whose hour is approximate (turn-weighted or fallback placement).

cache_saved_nanos.description: cache_read × (input rate − cache-read rate) from the catalog; 0 when a rate is missing.

hour.description: UTC epoch hour of the bucket = floor(unix_seconds / 3600).

input.description: Input tokens INCLUDING cache read and cache write.

model.description: Index into `models`.

method.agent.receiver.CostCube.description: `cost_cube(since)` answer: a full snapshot, or the changes since `since`.

epoch.description: Cube identity; a new one per engine start and full rebuild.

full.description: true: replace everything the client holds. false: a delta.

hours.description:
Delta only: every cell of these UTC hours is replaced by the cells of this answer
(cells carry every root of those hours). Empty when `full`.

kinds.description: Kind dictionary (complete, append-only within an epoch).

models.description: Model dictionary (complete, append-only within an epoch).

providers.description: Provider dictionary (complete, append-only within an epoch).

roots.description: Full: every root (ix = position). Delta: new or changed roots only.

vias.description: Via dictionary (complete, append-only within an epoch).

built_at_ms.description: When this cube state was built.

engine.description: This engine's name (the ledger is per engine, H4).

first_call_ms.description: Earliest native call or placed reported money.

pre_ledger_sessions.description: Sessions before the ledger existed (history_coverage = 'unknown'), H3.

price_table.description: Hash of the price table used for repricing and cache savings.

unpriced.description: Unpriced attempts by reason (status / unknown_reason), for the Basis card.

method.agent.receiver.CostModel.description: One model of the cube's model dimension.

name.description: Canonical display name (`claude-haiku-4-5`); aliases share it.

method.agent.receiver.CostRoot.description: One root session of the ledger, live or deleted — the cube's session dimension.

deleted.description: The root's session row is gone.

owner.description: Agent name, routine name, "you" or "other" (spend_report's rules, D6).

project.description: `sessions.project` of the root.

title.description: The root's title; "" for a deleted root (H1).

method.agent.receiver.CostRootEntry.description: A dimension entry with its stable index (indices never change within an epoch).

ix.description: Index the cells' `root` column points at.

method.agent.receiver.CostRule.description:
How a watch-only child's cost relates to its parent's (141 §7.6, D8).
Chosen by the adapter that sees the frame; stored by the agent crate.

oneOf.description:
The child's cost is its own meter rows and rolls up (omp background
spawns: excluded from the harness's `usage_update`).
Already inside the parent's meter; display-only (omp sync spawns).
Reported by the harness, not aggregated (RFD `idle.usage`).
A remote wrapper's inclusive charge; hidden descendants are inside it.

A watch-only harness subagent's own charge (141 §7.6 `counted`):
omp background rows, excluded from the harness's `usage_update`.

method.agent.receiver.Coverage.description: How completely a figure covers what it claims to (§6.2, §6.3).

method.agent.receiver.Delivery.description:
How a human input lands on a busy session (62 §0.3): `Steer` joins the
running turn after the current tool batch; `NextTurn` waits for the turn to
end. An idle session starts a turn now either way.

oneOf.description: Inject after the current tool batch (today's behaviour).
Hold until the running turn ends; opens the next one.

method.agent.receiver.DescribeImages.description: 201 §8: whether an image leaving the tail gets a one-line description.

oneOf.description: Never described; the unit keeps its name only.

method.agent.receiver.DocId.description:
A document id: 26 lowercase base32 characters (§4.1). Bound documents (knowledge, artifact,
meeting note) render uuid v5 of the binding key under [`DocId::NAMESPACE`], so every engine of a
mesh mints the same id for the same thing (69 §5); notes, which have no natural key, render uuid v7.

oneOf.description: A knowledge concept; the derived file is `knowledge/<id>.md` and the first block is the frontmatter.
An agent's charter — the body of `agents/<name>.md` (67 §6.1); the roster copies each export into the file.

A task's thread (67 §7.1): comments, answers and the event log of one task. Owned by the task,
so it never lists as a note.

A board (71 §2.1): a note the agent draws for a reader — sections, anchored prose, `Excerpt`s and
diagrams — bound like a note (`Binding::Note`, `documents/<id>/note.md`); its first block is the
frontmatter carrying `root:`, the absolute repository root every `code:` link and `ref` resolves against.

A notebook (144 §3.1): the container over notes, sources, sessions and artifacts. Its body is the
description the agent reads as a prompt block; its lists are `notebook_items` rows. Never lists
among notes.

A source (144 §3.1): read-only derived markdown of something fetched (file, URL, meeting, pasted
text, past session, MCP page, YouTube, audio, video) plus its insights. Bound by its origin key, so
the same thing is one document everywhere. Written by `Principal::Helper`/`File` only.

project.description: Project label the note or board is filed under (the sessions' vocabulary, one level); `None` = ungrouped.

method.agent.receiver.EndlessConfig.description:
`agent.endless` (137 §11.1). Every key optional in YAML; the whole struct
is what Settings › Memory reads and writes (`endless_settings_get/set`).

age_by_use.description: 201 §10: a zoomed line stays unmerged for one generation.

attempt_secs.description: 137F E6: one attempt's bound in seconds for a cloud compactor (10..=3600).

backfill_max_units.description: R1-D4: at switch-on the tree covers only the last this many units.

batch_units.description: 137G G6: consecutive unsummarized units one compactor call summarizes (1..=64).

cap_chars.description: Tool-result cap in chars before a unit is cut head ⅔ / tail ⅓ (§4).

cold_after_secs.description:
201 §4.3: idle seconds after which a trim is taken early (0..=86_400);
0 = the transport's cache lifetime.

compactor_ctx_bytes.description: 137G G3: the compactor's `<chat>` context cap in bytes for every model (8_000..=256_000); a local one takes the smaller of this and `local_ctx_bytes`.

default_desk.description: Desks without an explicit `memory:` field (R1-D7: on).

describe_images.description: 201 §8: one-line description when an image leaves the tail (`auto` | `off`).

effort.description:
194: the compactor model's effort; `None` = thinking off (R1 Q1). Only
with `model` (validated against it, dropped when a new `model` does not take it).

jobs.description: Compactor calls in flight per session.

ledger.description: 201 §9: the state ledger and its tool.

ledger_suggestions.description: 201 §9: summary-model flags shown as unconfirmed suggestions.

local_attempt_secs.description: 137F E6: one attempt's bound in seconds for a local compactor (30..=7200).

local_ctx_bytes.description: 137F E8: a local compactor sees at most this many bytes of the `<chat>` view, newest kept (4_000..=256_000).

local_jobs.description: 137F E9: compactor calls in flight per local endpoint, engine-wide (1..=16).

max_usd_per_call.description: 137G G11: USD one compactor call's prompt may cost (0.001..=10); over it the context shrinks, else the line folds mechanically.

max_usd_per_session_day.description: 137G G11: USD a chat's compactor may spend per UTC day (0..=1000, 0 = no cap); reaching it pauses settling (`paused_by: "spend"`).

meeting_view_bytes.description: View budget for a meeting head's `## Earlier in this meeting` (R1-D6).

merge_at.description: 201 §6: share of `view_bytes` at which merges start being built (0.50..=1.00).

model.description: Compactor model; `None` = the session's own model (D8).

node_bytes.description: One summary line's ceiling in bytes.

prefetch_bytes.description: 201 §10: recall hits appended to the input, in bytes (0..=8_000); 0 = off.

raw_bytes.description: 137G G2: unsummarized lines the view shows verbatim, newest first, in bytes (4_000..=128_000); older ones fold into one placeholder line.

retry_secs.description: Delay before a failed node is retried.

settle_secs.description: How long a turn waits for the view to be fully built (D10).

slack.description: Slack band of the fold (0.0..=0.5), D5.

tail_high_bytes.description: 201 §4.2 fixed mode: where a trim is due (16_000..=512_000); above the low mark.

tail_high_share.description: 201 §4.2 scaled mode: high mark as a share (0.05..=0.60); above the low share.

tail_low_bytes.description: 201 §4.2 fixed mode: verbatim context kept after a trim (8_000..=256_000).

tail_low_share.description: 201 §4.2 scaled mode: low mark as a share of the session model's turn allowance (0.02..=0.40).

tail_mode.description: 201 §4.2: how the verbatim tail is sized (`fixed` | `scaled`).

tries.description: Attempts per node before the best candidate wins (D7).

view_bytes.description: View budget in bytes (16_000..=256_000; R1-D2: 128 KB).

method.agent.receiver.EndlessStats.description: Per-session compactor totals (§6, the Memory panel header).

display.description:
A display is reachable: macOS/iOS/Windows always; Linux a Wayland/X11 display or the
node's watchable desktop (`desktop.json`).

hub.description: This engine holds the hub lease (`true` with no mesh).

mic.description:
An input device is listed (`list_input_devices`); without the voice plugin, the
startup audio probe.

desktop's own websockify, or a mesh tunnel to a peer's.

method.agent.receiver.EngineLogs.description: The tail of an engine's own log.

path.description: The file read on that engine; `None` when it has no log yet.

An interactive shell on an engine: attach with `subscribe_pty(session,
job, rows, cols, engine)`, type with `pty_input(…, engine)`.

session.description: The engine's owner root session holding the job.

auth_methods.description: Authentication methods advertised in `initialize.authMethods` during probe.

method.agent.receiver.EscalateModel.description: The escalation slot as the UI shows it: what is set and what would answer.

effective.description:
The model a tier-2 call uses today: `model`, else the title model;
`None` = each session's own model.

model.description: `agent.escalate_model`, if set.

method.agent.receiver.GraphEdge.description: 208 D8: the peer messages between one unordered pair of nodes, `a < b` (byte order of the ids).

ba.description: Exchanges sent b → a in the window.

results.description: Of those, a child's final result to its parent (request id `result:*`).

`serde_json::Value`.

agent.description: The harness (`agents.yaml` key) of an ACP session; `None` for theuth sessions.

The session's model id ("" for boundary nodes). A harness child shows
the model its harness reports (`harness_model`), never the harness name.

The last turn's outcome while the session is not running; `None` before any turn, while running, and for

remote.description: Owned by another engine: state is last-known (208 §6).

root.description: The root of the node's tree (itself for a root, desk or boundary node).

title.description: Root/desk: the title (empty → `<desk> desk`, else the short id); child: the peer name; boundary: the name.

waits.description: What it waits on besides its state, sorted, deduplicated.

method.agent.receiver.GraphNodeKind.description: 208 D9: what a graph node is.

A subagent: native, or an ACP harness child (`agent` set).
A watch-only child a harness runs inside itself (141 D2).
A boundary endpoint outside this engine's sessions: a mesh peer or a contact (`peer:<name>`).

method.agent.receiver.GraphOutcome.description: 208 D7: how the session's last turn ended (207 §4's mapping of `stop_reason`).

method.agent.receiver.GraphWait.description: 208 D7: what a session is parked on besides its `AgentState`.

oneOf.description: A pending question to the user: ask, hand-off or secret (`waits.kind = 'question'`).

method.agent.receiver.HarnessCommand.description:
One entry of an external harness's command manifest
(`available_commands_update`, design doc 75 §3). omp announces loaded
skills as `skill:<name>` and extension commands as `/ponytail…`;
opencode strips the source, so skills and commands are indistinguishable.

hint.description: `input.hint`: what the command takes after its name, when it takes input.

method.agent.receiver.HistoryEntry.description:
Rendered history for UIs (tool traffic collapsed to summaries). Every
variant carries `context`: the stored row's context-removal identity and
membership (design doc 48 §3.3) — the actual message (not its turn
opener) for user/assistant text, the backing response row for a tool

unstored live card (a call still running), or when the read failed.

channel.description:
172: the channel that delivered this row (`messages.channel`);
`None` for every other row, and for rows stored before 172.

peer.description:
Set when a peer exchange produced this row (design doc 50 §9):
typed provenance for replay, the same shape [`PeerDelivered`]
carries live. `None` for the owner's own input and harness notes.

turn.description:
Own seq when this row opens a turn (design doc 29 §4.3); `None`
for steers and harness notes, which are not addressable.

vision.description:
Set when this row is a vision consultation note (design doc 52 §6):
the typed record of which images were inspected and how it went.
The body text is the note itself. `None` for every other user row.

context.description: Context membership of the stored assistant row.

turn.description:
Seq of the user row that opened the turn this reply belongs to
(design doc 29 §4.3).

The thinking the assistant did before the reply or tool calls that
follow it (70 THINKING-TRACES): the stored row's `ReasoningContent`
parts, so a reload shows the same collapsed block the live
`ReasoningDelta` stream built.

thinking_ms.description:
91: ms the model thought; `None` for rows written before 91 and
for harness (ACP) sessions.

turn.description: Seq of the user row that opened the turn (design doc 29 §4.3).

A tool call and its result; `result` is `None` while the call is
still running (a session loaded mid-turn), and `ToolCallFinished`
with the same `call_id` completes it.

Context membership of the backing response row; attachments are
this response's images only (siblings in the same row are on
their own cards). `None` while the call is still running.

files.description: Files the tool produced (23 §5), for UIs that render them inline.

result.description: `(output, is_error)` once finished; output possibly truncated.

oneOf.description:
A compaction boundary: everything before it was folded into `summary`
(design doc 07 §8.4).

context.description:
Context membership of the epoch head (`ContextTarget::Head`);
attachments are snap images.

style.description: How the head was built; missing on old rows → summary.

summary.description: The summary text the model works from.

`AgentEvent::Error`, replayed in transcript order behind the message
it followed. UI-only: never in the model frame, so nothing to remove.

text.description: Same text the live event carried.

oneOf.description:
109 §8.2: the streamed partial of an open turn's model call, dropped
when the resumed turn regenerates it. UI-only, never in the frame.

at.description: When the partial was last checkpointed.

context.description: Always `None`: a partial is not model context.

user row with typed `messages.advisory` metadata (the vision
pattern); never opens a turn. The row's text is the model-facing
rendering, the card renders from `advisory`.

oneOf.description:
183 §5.3 (W-8): a move or take of this session, stored as a user row
with typed `messages.moved` metadata (the Advisory pattern); never
opens a turn. The row's text is `<session_moved/>`, the card renders
from `moved`.

method.agent.receiver.InState.description: An incoming file's state; `Received` and `Failed` are terminal.

oneOf.description: Verified; being linked into place (resolved by inode on restart).
Published while its exchange is still `accepted` or `held`: waits for it.
Published, and its notice durably queued.

method.agent.receiver.InputId.description:
One user input, identified by its sender so it can be shown before any
reply arrives.

method.agent.receiver.InsightRun.description: `insight_run` reply: the first block id of the appended `###` section.

oneOf.description: A `SessionId` (owner-only; never covered by the derived share grant, D13).
