oneOf.description: The command returned this code (a shell error is `1`).

The job's deadline (`tools.job_timeout_secs`, or the call's shorter
`timeout_secs`) elapsed; the process group was killed.

[`CancelJob`] killed the process group; the [`CancelOrigin`] decides
what the model hears about it.

109 §5.4: the job died with the engine (or was reaped after a
SIGKILL leaked it); its exit code is unknown. Never produced by a
running job — written by the journal's reaper and the shutdown path.

`running` | `exited 0` | `timeout` | `killed` | `lost` (109 §5.4: died

method.agent.receiver.PeerInfo.description:
One row of the permitted directory (§5.1). No title, brief, cwd, model,
tools or transcript of another root; `name` is the same-tree brief name
or the owner's explicit alias.

activity.description: Liveness detail (62 §0.7); `None` for a remote peer (a card is not a heartbeat).

The engine owning the session (69 P): this one's display name for a

The title model's keywords for the session (07 §15 as-built): every

Reply to [`ListPeerMessages`]. Pending sets derive from live waiters,
never abandoned oneshots; after an engine restart the waiters of open
turns are rebuilt from the `waits` rows (109 §4.4, `Agents::rebuild_waits`),
so those requests stay pending, and a request's durable outcome is its `state`.

awaiting_answer.description:
Received requests whose sender is blocked awaiting `session`'s
answer: "answer on behalf of this session"; the answer reaches the
sender as a peer message from `session`, recorded
`answered_by = owner:<session>`.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; `None` at the end.

method.agent.receiver.PeerMessageState.description:
Outcome of one peer exchange (§5.2). `Accepted` means committed to the
recipient's intake, not "read".

ACP turn tokens in the subtree per harness and model (75 §7); empty
for a native-only subtree.

revision.description: Opaque revision; bumped by every ledger mutation touching this owner or a descendant.

scope.description: Native, or an inclusive remote meter owner.

method.agent.receiver.SessionId.description: Identifies a conversation; every event carries one.

method.agent.receiver.SessionKind.description:
What a `sessions` row is (125 §6.2): an ordinary chat, the hidden
`advisor` child that reviews its parent's transcript (ruling 1), a
watch-only `observed` subagent a harness runs inside itself (141 D2), or
an `ask` run across notebooks (144 §9). Stored as `sessions.kind`;
readers hide advisors unless asked.

oneOf.description: The hidden advisor session of its parent (125 §4).

A watch-only child a harness runs inside itself (141 §5): `parent` =
the ACP child (or an observed parent when nested), no `agent`,
`acp_session` = the harness's own id. Never driven, never messaged.

An "ask across notebooks" session (144 §9): a normal durable root
without a notebook binding whose first turn is the planned,
branched answer the engine wrote; the user keeps asking in it.
Listed by `notebook_ask_list`, otherwise a chat.

method.agent.receiver.SessionKnowledgeHa.description:
One session's own knowledge harvester (`session_knowledge_harvesters`): `model:
None` = the default (`agent.knowledge_harvester_model`, else the session's model).

effort.description: The effort of `model`; `None` = no setting. Always `None` without `model`.

model.description: This session's own pick; `None` = the default.

backfill.description: D14 progress while history is being covered.

backlog.description: 137G: the unsettled backlog; `None` when nothing waits and the session is not paused.

drafts.description: 201 §5: units whose line is still a draft. Phase P1 fills it; 0 until then.

effort.description:
194: the effort `model` runs with — this chat's own pick
(`set_session_compactor_effort`), else the effort of the link that chose
`model` (the agent's `memory_effort`, `agent.endless.effort`); `None` =
thinking off. An effort `model` does not take is dropped (`None`).

effort_override.description:
194 R1: this chat's own compactor effort (`set_session_compactor_effort`),
stored beside `model_override`; `None` = inherit. The panel's chips show it.

generation.description: 201 §4.3: trims taken so far (the view's generation). Phase P2 fills it; 0 until then.

ledger.description:
201 §9 (P6a): the state ledger's open entries per section, its
suggestions and the frozen snapshot's bytes; `None` when the ledger is
off, for a meeting or an epochs session.

model.description: Compactor model id; `""` for an epochs session.

model_override.description: 137G: this chat's own compactor pick (`set_session_compactor_model`); `None` = inherit.

model_source.description:
137G: which link chose `model`: `"chat"` | `"agent"` | `"settings"` | `"title"` | `"session"`;
`""` for an epochs session.

profile.description:
201 §7.1: the resolved compactor profile, never `auto`. Phase P3
resolves it; `standard` until then.

profile_reason.description:
201 §7.1: why `profile` was chosen, short text ("the model is local").
Phase P3 fills it; `""` until then.

settling.description: Some view part is still being built.

spend_today_usd.description: 137G G11: this chat's compactor spend in the current UTC day (USD, `model_calls` kind `endless`).

stalled.description: 137F: the failing node that blocks most; `None` when nothing is failing.

tail_bytes.description: 201 §4.1: bytes of the verbatim tail now. Phase P2 fills it; 0 until then.

tail_high.description: 201 §4.2: the high mark in force, in bytes; as `tail_low`.

tail_low.description:
201 §4.2: the low mark in force, in bytes ([`EndlessConfig::tail_marks`]).
In `scaled` mode 0 until phase P2 knows the session model's allowance.

tail_mode.description:
201 §4.2: the tail sizing in force for this session (the session's
override, else `agent.endless.tail_mode`).

tail_override.description: 201 §4.2: this chat's own tail override (`set_session_tail`); `None` = inherit.

tools_pending.description:
201 §11 (P6b): a tool-list change waits for the next trim (new tools
announced and callable through the runtime, removed ones refusing).

unbuilt.description: Parts rendered per D10 right now.

view_bytes.description: The view budget in force (R1b: the session's own, else `agent.endless.view_bytes`).

zooms.description:
201 §10 (P6b): `zoom` calls during the generation in force (the page
faults that keep lines unmerged at the next trim).

method.agent.receiver.SessionMoved.description:
183 §5.3 (W-8): the typed record of one move or take, written by the
taker as a user row (`messages.moved`, the [`Advisory`] pattern) whose
text is the model-facing `<session_moved/>` (§11.1). Never opens a turn.

approvals.description: `ask` | `off`: effective approvals after the row's pin.

cwd.description: The effective cwd on the taker (the fallback when `cwd_missing`).

cwd_missing.description: The session's cwd does not exist on the taker (W-9).

cwd_was.description: The original cwd, set only when `cwd_missing`.

jobs_left.description: Running jobs that stayed on the origin.

messaging.description: Agent messaging is on for the session.

os_name.description: Display OS of the taker (`macOS`, `Arch Linux`, …).

pending.description: The open turn waits for Resume (resume = ask); the row is out of context.

method.agent.receiver.SessionOpen.description:
Reply to `create_session` / `resume_private`: the opened session, its
root, and for a private root the lease secret the owner presents on
resume and leave.

lease_secret.description:
Private roots only: the secret presented on `resume_private` and
`leave_session`; rotated on every resume.

root.description: Root of its tree (`session` itself for a fresh root).

session.description: The session that was opened or resumed.

method.agent.receiver.SessionSummary.description: One row of the session list.

agent.description: External harness (`agents.yaml` key) when this is an ACP child (design doc 06).

archived.description:
Hidden from the sidebar (51 §3): the root's flag, shown on every row
of its tree. Still listed and searchable.

context_size.description: Context window size the external harness reported (75 §5).

cwd.description: Working directory recorded by ACP (`session/new` or `spawn_subagent.cwd`).

desk.description:
The roster agent whose desk this session is (67 §6.2); chat lists drop
these rows, the Desks group shows them.

effort.description: Reasoning effort in force; `None` = provider default.

epoch.description: Ownership epoch; bumps on every transfer (68 §4.2).

harness_model.description: Model the external harness reports for its session (design doc 06 §8.2).

here.description: The owner is this engine: writes are served locally, not forwarded.

kind.description: Row kind (125 §6.2); `chat` from an older harness.

memory.description: Memory mode (137 D1): `epochs` from an older harness.

model.description: Model used.

notebook.description: 144 §8: the notebook this chat is bound to (root metadata like `project`); `None` = plain chat.

owner.description:
Engine that holds the live actor and writes the transcript (68 §2):
its mesh `EngineId` as text; `""` on a lone engine that never joined a mesh.

parent.description: Parent session when this is a subagent.

pinned.description: Kept at the top of the list.

project.description:
Effective project label (51 §3): stored on the root, shown on every
row of its tree.

retention.description: Storage class of the root (51 §4); durable unless created private.

running.description:
A turn is in flight: the supervisor's live `TurnStarted`/`TurnFinished`
view (what `AgentState::Running` means); `false` on a bare store row.

tags.description:
Keywords the title model assigned beside the title (`[a-z0-9-]`, at
most four); empty until the first model-written title.

title.description: Model-written name of what the session is about now (07 §15); the first input, truncated, until then.

updated_at.description: Last activity: creation or the last appended message. The list order.

method.agent.receiver.SetOptionResult.description:
Reply of `set_harness_option` (75 §8): the option list after the change,
or the list as it stands when the change is queued behind the turn in flight.

options.description: The harness's options now.

pending.description: The change is queued and lands when the current turn ends.

method.agent.receiver.ShareLink.description:
A share link (§8.2). `secret_hash_sealed` is what the harness holds — the §8.3 HMAC key,
`sha256(secret)`, sealed with the mesh data key (SEAL) so the replicated `meta.json` never
carries it in the clear; on the wire (`doc_members`, `doc_open`) it is blanked.

expires_ms.description: Expiry, if any.

secret_hash_sealed.description:
base64url(nonce ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(mesh key, aad = link id, sha256(secret))); empty on
the wire. Opened by `share.rs` at proof time; pre-SEAL plaintext `secret_hash` is sealed on
load ([`crate::store::Store::parse_meta`]).

method.agent.receiver.ShareMode.description:
186 (D1): how a contact share collaborates. 190: every share is `Full`: the contact's
message arrives like a mesh peer's, the receiving agent replies with
`send_message(reply_to)` any number of times and the chat's own tool policy applies.
`Cautious` (183's one capped turn per message, the reply the turn text) is only read: from
old rows and an older contact's card (absent = cautious).

files.description: Other files of a `SKILL.md` skill, relative to its directory; empty otherwise.

always.description: Inlined into the system prompt instead of indexed.

name.description: Name (front matter, else file stem / directory name).

path.description: Absolute path of the skill file.

repo.description: Clone directory name when the skill lives in a git repo under skills/.

method.agent.receiver.Source.description:
One source as `source_list` / `source_get` show it (144 §13.1): the document plus the `sources` row.
TS name `NotebookSource`: `knowledge::Source` already owns `Source.ts`.

changed_since.description: The previous `fetched_ms` when a refresh changed the text and the source has not been opened since.

content_sha.description: sha256 of the derived markdown at the last success.

error.description: Why it failed, when it did.

insights.description: Insight sections written at the end of the document.

meta.description: Extractor metadata (author, published date, page title, …), shown verbatim.

words.description: Word count of the derived markdown.

method.agent.receiver.SourceOrigin.description: Where a source came from (144 §4.1); stored as JSON in `sources.origin`, shown verbatim on the source page.

oneOf.description: A file from disk or an upload (`file:<sha256>`).

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes, lowercase hex.
sha256 of the text, lowercase hex.

title.description: The title the user gave, or the first line.

label.description: Which skin: Confluence, Jira or other.

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes, lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: A video file (`file:<sha256>`, audio track transcribed).

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes, lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: Row written, card exists; not yet queued.
Text imported, indexed, default insight written.
`error` says why; `415 unsupported`, `too large`, `refused` are permanent.

day.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` in the engine host's local timezone.

unresolved.description: Attempts with neither returned nor estimated money.

method.agent.receiver.SpendOwner.description: Spend of the report window attributed to one owner.

method.agent.receiver.SpendOwnerKind.description: Who a root session's calls belong to.

oneOf.description: The user's own roots, folded into one row named `you`.
A scheduler-opened root (`sessions.unattended` on a root).
Roots whose session row is gone, folded into one row.

method.agent.receiver.SpendReport.description:
What `spend_report` answers (128 Rev 3): the last `days` local days,
oldest first, the month to date, and the window's top owners.

days.description: One entry per local day, oldest first, today last; a day with no calls is `$0.00`.

month.description: The current local month to date (`day` = `YYYY-MM`).

owners.description: Top 8 owners of the window by `usd`.

method.agent.receiver.Stalled.description: A view part that keeps failing to build (137F). Engine → UI.

blocking.description: The failing node is the level-0 frontier: newer lines wait behind it.

error.description: The last error, one line, ≤ 300 chars (secrets never appear: it is the provider's message).

failures.description: Consecutive failed attempts of the failing node that blocks most (the frontier first).

model.description: The compactor model id that failed.

next_retry_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the pump's own next retry; `None` while a retry is running.

oneOf.description: Being worked on (at most one, kept by normalization).
Waiting on user input or another external prerequisite (`reason` says which).

model.description: The resolved model id.

ok.description: A summary line came back and passed the guards.

reasoning_seen.description: The reply carried reasoning (chunks or reasoning tokens).

thinking_off_sent.description: The request switched thinking off (`chat_template_kwargs`, `think:false`, or an effort).

method.agent.receiver.SyncBacklog.description:
`advisor.sync_backlog` (125 §4.12): how many pending deltas the advised
loop waits for at turn end; `off` never waits.

method.agent.receiver.TailMode.description: 201 §4.2: how the verbatim tail is sized.

oneOf.description: `tail_low_share` / `tail_high_share` of the session model's turn allowance.

method.agent.receiver.TailOverride.description:
201 §4.2: a per-session (or per-agent) tail override: the mode and its two
marks in that mode's unit — bytes for `fixed`, shares of the turn
allowance for `scaled`. Stored on the session row beside `endless_view_bytes`.

high.description: High mark: bytes (16_000..=512_000) or share (0.05..=0.60); above `low`.

method.agent.receiver.TerminalSummary.description: One PTY job as `list_terminals` reports it (51 §7.3).

epoch.description: Daemon epoch; `None` until the harness has one.

revision.description: Bumps on every rendered change and once at exit; see [`PtyScreen::if_revision`].

rows.description: Screen height.

method.agent.receiver.Todo.description: One item; identified by its exact text.

reason.description: Why the item is blocked; `Some` iff `status == Blocked`.

text.description: The item, as the model wrote it.

method.agent.receiver.TodoSnapshot.description: The canonical plan of one session: a full list, replacing any earlier one (47 §5.1).

version.description: Monotonic per session, including rewind; `0` means "never had a plan".

method.agent.receiver.TodoSource.description: Who owns the plan a snapshot shows (47 §5.1/§5.3).

method.agent.receiver.TokenTotals.description: Token sums over a bucket's calls.

unknown_calls.description: Settled calls that reported no tokens at all.

method.agent.receiver.ToolCategoryInfo.description: One tool category as an app shows it.

builtin_count.description: Number of registered native tools in [`Self::builtin_tools`].

builtin_tools.description: Registered native tool names in this category, sorted by name.

custom.description: Whether this is a user-created rather than default category.

default_enabled.description: Whether the category is enabled in brand-new root interactive sessions.

hidden.description: Whether the requested session or an ancestor hides this category.

id.description: Stable id; its session hide key is `tcat:<id>`.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server names assigned to this category, sorted by name.

method.agent.receiver.ToolOutput.description:
Result returned to the model. Errors are content, not `Err`: the model
must see them.

content.description: Text handed back to the model.

files.description:
Files handed to the model as image parts of the tool result (23 §5):
paths, not bytes, like `files` on inputs (17 §2). Empty for most tools.

is_error.description: Marks the output as a failure for providers that distinguish.

method.agent.receiver.TurnId.description: One model round trip within a session.

method.agent.receiver.UsageSample.description: One observed reading of a usage window.

at_ms.description: When the reading was observed (Unix ms).

method.agent.receiver.UsageWindow.description: A subscription usage window (Codex primary/secondary, Claude 5-hour/weekly…).

history.description: Readings of the current window, oldest first, newest last (may be empty).

built.description: A built summary line (not a placeholder).

mechanical.description: 137G: a line made by the mechanical fold (an excerpt, not a model summary).

args.description: Tool arguments as evaluated by the renderer.

oneOf.description: `SUSPICIOUS: <reason>` with `on_suspicious: revert` — the keep was undone.

case_values.description: 159 §5.3 CASE v2: `id → name → value`, names kept; `cases` stays the id's last value.

failure.description:

n.description: Experiment number (0 = a baseline/holdout outside an experiment).

noisy.description: Load precondition missed: excluded from σ.

slot_holders.description: Owners of the machine's build slots at start (`pid label epoch argv` lines; §5.5).

spend_nanos.description: 159 §5.3: Σ `SPEND` lines of the run, USD nanos (the Bench spend channel).

method.autoresearch.output.SessionId.description: Identifies a conversation; every event carries one.

seen_in.description: The first experiment whose brief carried it.

oneOf.description: Stop now (the experiment in flight was discarded).

citations.description: 159 W5: the citation of every literature idea in `ideas`.

needs_eyes.description: Attention items: reverted, deviations, overfit, drift (one line each).

tail.description: The last 30 lines / 4 KiB of the running sample's log while an experiment is measuring.

view.description: 159 §5.7: what the Study view switches on; `Scalar` = `series` as today.

method.autoresearch.output.StudyInfo.description: One study in the list (140 §12.5 `autoresearch.list`, the TUI line, the routines badge).

baseline_mean.description: The study base's measured mean (segment 0's baseline); `delta_pct` is vs this.

created_by.description:

headline.description: One line: "Optimising time_ms in liquid · 34 experiments · −14.2 % · running".

method.autoresearch.output.StudySpec.description:

axes.description: The six axes of 159 §3; `Default` = the 140 study.

base.description: Ref resolved to a sha at Start (`HEAD` default).

checks.description: Pass/fail correctness check, run only on would-be keeps.

evaluator_paths.description: Repo files the evaluator reads: custody + hashes (140 §5.3).

goal.description: What the user wants, one sentence.

holdout.description: The holdout the study session never sees (140 §5.4).

include_dirty.description:

off_limits.description: Globs that can never be kept.

secondary_guards.description: Secondaries a keep may not regress past their limit.

window.description: A 40 `when:` sensor confining the study to an idle window (140 §5.5).

world.description: W6: deploy, measure, rollback, exposure, windows.

oneOf.description: The card is shown; nothing on disk but the draft.

fixture suite the outer study scores on. Empty lists mean the §14 suite; 0 means the
§12 constant (2 seeds, 8 inner experiments); `executor` is the inner studies' model.

held_out.description: Held-out fixtures (the outer holdout; never in the brief).

oneOf.description: Non-zero exit, timeout, missing primary, NaN.
A secondary regressed past its limit.
Refused before a sample was spent.

Granted keep-simpler (not worse, fewer lines, checks pass).

159 W6: a world launch waiting for its press or window; not a keep candidate.

until.description: `"your approval"` or the window's end, RFC 3339.

method.autoresearch.output.WorldSpec.description:

field defaults, so `world: {}` is a valid block that only lacks its commands.

alpha_harm.description: Harm level: Λ ≥ 1/α_harm with Δ̂ worsening; default 0.05.

deploy.description:
Custody command that puts one arm live: gets `AUTORESEARCH_ARM`, `AUTORESEARCH_TREE`,
`AUTORESEARCH_ARM_WORKTREE`, `AUTORESEARCH_EXPOSURE`, `AUTORESEARCH_N`.

exposure.description: Share of traffic both arms take together (each gets half); default 0.1.

max_windows.description: Windows before the launch ends inconclusive; default 14.

measure.description: Custody command printing `CASE <arm> units=<n> mean=<x> var=<v> [<name>=<v> …]` per arm.

measure_tool.description: A read-only registry tool (listed in `calls`) read instead of `measure` (W-d).

min_units.description: Units per arm before a keep may be called; default 500.

min_windows.description: Windows before a keep may be called; default 2.

rollback.description: Custody command that takes one arm down; idempotent (setup runs it once on the base).

tau.description: The effect the user expects, in metric units; `None` = `metric.min_effect` of the base mean.

timeout.description: One deploy/measure/rollback command's limit, humantime; default `600s`.

agreed.description: Human answers that matched the judge's double verdict.

method.autoresearch.receiver.ArchiveRow.description: `archive` row (159 §5.4): a W1 front member or a W4 cell elite.

method.autoresearch.receiver.ArmWindow.description: One arm in one window (W6; `observations` row).

oneOf.description: A text file, in a repo or a plugin-made scratch repo (W2).

bench.description: The bench slot and load precondition (140 §5.5).

confirm_budget_usd.description: Draft cards above this `budget.usd` need the user to type the amount.

defaults.description: Pre-filled values of a new draft (R1-D1).

enabled.description: `false`: no tools, no prompt block, no RPC beyond "disabled"; existing study files stay paused.

git.description: Git author for the plugin's commits (140 §6).

keep_finished_days.description: Worktrees of finished studies are removed after this many days.

max_parallel.description: Largest `parallel:` a spec may ask for (140 §10).

models.description:

194: each role's effort sits beside its model (`models.*_effort`, `review.effort`).

search.description: What the next candidate is cut from (`ratchet` + `parallel > 1` = waves).

exclusive.description: Take the machine bench slot per scored sample.

smoke.description: Seconds-long pre-check before the first scored sample; non-zero = crash.

hours.description: Wall hours since Start, excluding paused time.

usd.description: USD (sum of `model_calls.cost` over the study session tree).

oneOf.description: The user: a button, a slash command, a root chat.
Significantly worse past the tolerated loss.

objectives.description: Objectives with roles (159 §5.2); empty = one primary from `metric` plus the guards.

off_limits.description: Globs that can never be kept.

secondary_guards.description: Secondaries a keep may not regress past their limit.

window.description: A 40 `when:` sensor confining the study to an idle window (140 §5.5).

world.description: W6: deploy, measure, rollback, exposure, windows.

oneOf.description: The card is shown; nothing on disk but the draft.
`enabled: false` on the schedule file; the experiment in flight finishes.
Report delivered; worktree kept until landed or swept.
The user discarded it (draft or finished).

incumbent.description: Normalised holdout gain under the incumbent mechanism.

method.autoresearch.receiver.SuiteSpec.description:
W7 (159 §12): `suite: {training, held_out, seeds, inner_experiments, executor}` — the
fixture suite the outer study scores on. Empty lists mean the §14 suite; 0 means the
§12 constant (2 seeds, 8 inner experiments); `executor` is the inner studies' model.

executor.description: The inner studies' executor; `None` = the outer study's.

held_out.description: Held-out fixtures (the outer holdout; never in the brief).

oneOf.description: Non-zero exit, timeout, missing primary, NaN.
A secondary regressed past its limit.
Refused before a sample was spent.

reason.description: The refusal text the model sees.

oneOf.description: A keep-candidate flagged for review (jump above `z_suspicious` or 3× the largest step).
Granted keep-simpler (not worse, fewer lines, checks pass).
159 W1: entered the front without dominating its parent; a keep candidate.
159 W6: a world launch waiting for its press or window; not a keep candidate.

until.description: `"your approval"` or the window's end, RFC 3339.

method.autoresearch.receiver.WorldSpec.description:
W6: `world: {deploy, rollback, measure, exposure, window, min_units, min_windows,
max_windows, alpha, alpha_harm, tau, timeout}` (159 §11 "The world block"). Every
field defaults, so `world: {}` is a valid block that only lacks its commands.

alpha_harm.description: Harm level: Λ ≥ 1/α_harm with Δ̂ worsening; default 0.05.

deploy.description:
Custody command that puts one arm live: gets `AUTORESEARCH_ARM`, `AUTORESEARCH_TREE`,
`AUTORESEARCH_ARM_WORKTREE`, `AUTORESEARCH_EXPOSURE`, `AUTORESEARCH_N`.

exposure.description: Share of traffic both arms take together (each gets half); default 0.1.

max_windows.description: Windows before the launch ends inconclusive; default 14.

measure.description: Custody command printing `CASE <arm> units=<n> mean=<x> var=<v> [<name>=<v> …]` per arm.

measure_tool.description: A read-only registry tool (listed in `calls`) read instead of `measure` (W-d).

min_units.description: Units per arm before a keep may be called; default 500.

min_windows.description: Windows before a keep may be called; default 2.

rollback.description: Custody command that takes one arm down; idempotent (setup runs it once on the base).

tau.description: The effect the user expects, in metric units; `None` = `metric.min_effect` of the base mean.

timeout.description: One deploy/measure/rollback command's limit, humantime; default `600s`.

Which cell (§3.4). Chat: the assistant message `entry` and the 1-based position among
its *cells*; note: the doc and the cell's `name`, else its BlockNote block id.

oneOf.description: A cell in an assistant reply.

method.cells.input.DocId.description:
A document id: 26 lowercase base32 characters (§4.1). Bound documents (knowledge, artifact,
meeting note) render uuid v5 of the binding key under [`DocId::NAMESPACE`], so every engine of a
mesh mints the same id for the same thing (69 §5); notes, which have no natural key, render uuid v7.

instance.description:
Which instance of `(scope, spec)` (issue 6): 0 is the kernel every run uses; a
press while every instance is busy starts the next one (shells only), seeded with
the busy kernel's cwd and exported environment. The strip shows instance `n > 0`
as "zsh #n+1".

method.cells.input.KernelSpec.description: The resolved program of a kernel (§5.1–5.2); each distinct path is its own kernel.

oneOf.description: A python interpreter running the shim.

method.cells.input.NoteKey.description:
How a note cell is addressed (171 §15.1): by its `name:` header or by its
block id.

method.cells.input.RunId.description: Run id: `r_` + ULID, minted by the pressing client (§5.10); a retried press is idempotent.

method.cells.input.RunMode.description: What part of a cell a press runs (§7.1); offsets count code lines from 1, header excluded.

method.cells.input.Scope.description: The kernel scope (§5.1): a chat session or a note.

method.cells.input.SessionId.description: Identifies a conversation; every event carries one.

method.cells.input.ShellKind.description: Which shell runs a shell cell (§5.2).

summary.description: Its summary, shown on the armed line.

method.cells.output.CellLatest.description:
One replicated latest-output row of a note cell (171 §13.2 `cell_latest`,
minus the HLC column).

code_sha.description: Digest of the code that ran.

engine.description: 184 §6.4: the engine that ran it; `""` for a row from a pre-184 engine (old columns only).

text.description: Cleaned, redacted head+tail; `""` for a private cell.

method.cells.output.CellOutput.description: One nbformat v4 output (§8.1); `output_type` is the tag, as in nbformat.

oneOf.description: stdout / stderr text (shells: one, the static render, ANSI kept).

oneOf.description: A cell in an assistant reply.

method.cells.output.CellRun.description: The run record (§8.4) as clients see it.

edited.description: The user edited the code before the press (F4).

input.description: Set while the run's kernel waits on `input()`; cleared once `cell_input` answers.

masked.description: How many values the agent's copy masked (§9.4: vault values + credential patterns).

host.description:

interpreter.description: What the next press would use.

member_edit.description: Member pub8 when a member wrote the block since the owner's last run (§13.1).

superseded_by.description: A later reply re-presented the name (§3.5).

method.cloudnodes.input.NodeSpec.description: What the user asked for (wizard step 2).

desktop.description:
A watchable desktop on the node (Xvfb + noVNC behind loopback; watched over the mesh).
`None` = on (the default).

name.description: 1-40 of `[a-z0-9-]`, starting with a letter, not ending in `-` (also the mesh name).

region.description: Provider region slug; ignored for Kubernetes.

oneOf.description: Droplet + Block Storage volume + Cloud Firewall; native install under systemd.
App + Volume + Machine (Machines API); the engine image. Beta: never live-tested.

Lightsail instance + disk. Coming soon: listed, not creatable.

method.cloudnodes.output.CloudList.description:
`cloud_list`: every node from local records and every connected provider's tagged
resources; a provider that fails is reported in `errors`, not fatal.

errors.description: Providers that could not be listed.

method.cloudnodes.output.CloudNode.description: One cloud node (a row in Settings › Machines).

auto_update.description: Follows stable releases (always true for nodes this builds).

created_ms.description: When this engine created it (Unix ms).

error.description: Why the create job or the last operation failed.

ip.description: Public IPv4 (no port is open on it).

monthly_usd.description:
Server + disk per month from the provider's live prices (a kept disk alone); `None` when
unknown, and always in events.

peer_id.description: Its mesh endpoint id once joined.

version.description: `t --version` on the node, when it answered.

method.cloudnodes.output.CredentialSourc.description: Where the credential the engine would use comes from.

oneOf.description: `Sign in with DigitalOcean` (tokens from the relay's code exchange; refreshable).
Copied from a discovered CLI login on the user's press.
Kubernetes: kubectl and the user's kubeconfig (nothing stored).

method.cloudnodes.output.DesktopOpen.description:
`cloud_desktop`: a noVNC endpoint on this engine that tunnels over the mesh to the node's
loopback websockify, and its password. An owner-only RPC answer, never in an event (as
`sandbox_desktop_access`).

method.cloudnodes.output.Discovered.description:
A credential found on this machine (read-only discovery; nothing is copied until the user
presses "Use it" → `cloud_import_credential`). Never carries the secret itself.

detail.description: More: `context "default"`, `org personal`, `3 contexts`.

id.description: Stable id to pass back to `cloud_import_credential` (`doctl:default`, `flyctl`, `kube:<context>`).

label.description: What the UI says: "doctl login", "flyctl login", "kubeconfig context rwx-dev".

path.description: The file it was read from (`~/.config/doctl/config.yaml`).

method.cloudnodes.output.K8sInfo.description: `cloud_k8s_info`: what the Kubernetes variant of step 2 needs.

cni.description: The CNI detected from kube-system pods/daemonsets (`flannel`, `calico`, `cilium`, …).

enforces_network_policy.description: `false` for a CNI known not to enforce NetworkPolicy (flannel); `None` when unknown.

namespaces.description: Namespaces in the chosen context (empty when the user may not list them).

no_default_class.description: No class is marked default (a PVC without a class stays Pending).

context.description: kubeconfig context (default: the current one).

create_namespace.description: Create `namespace` when it does not exist.

deny_cluster_network.description: Add a NetworkPolicy: no ingress; egress to DNS and the internet, not the cluster.

storage_class.description: StorageClass of the volumes (default: the cluster's default).

oneOf.description: A direct connection (the node keeps its public IPv4 for this).

method.cloudnodes.output.NodeLogs.description: `cloud_logs`: the tail of the node engine's own log, read over the mesh.

lines.description: Oldest first, redacted by the node.

oneOf.description: The create job stopped (see `error`); destroy cleans up.
A restart / resize / update is in progress.

Found at the provider by its tags, with no record on this engine (made elsewhere, or the
record was lost). Destroy works on it.
Destroyed with its disk kept (provider still bills the disk).

`cloud_oauth_start`: open `url` in the system browser; completion arrives as
[`CloudEvent::CloudCredentialChanged`].

url.description: theuth-relay's start URL (no secret in it).

method.cloudnodes.output.ProviderInfo.description: One provider as the wizard shows it.

available.description: Can create nodes in this build (Lightsail: false).

connected.description: A usable credential is in the vault (or, for Kubernetes, kubectl has contexts).

desktop_only.description: Only offered where kubectl runs (desktop engines).

discovered.description: Credentials found on this machine, offered first on desktop.

oauth.description: "Sign in with DigitalOcean" works (the relay is reachable and this provider has OAuth).

source.description: Where the stored credential came from.

volume_usd_per_gb.description: Disk price per GB-month (`None` for Kubernetes).

method.cloudnodes.output.Quote.description:
The monthly cost the create button names (owner: the press on "Create node · $13/mo" is the
approval).

server_usd.description: Server per month, live from the provider; `None` when unknown.

total_usd.description: `server + disk`, rounded to cents; `None` for Kubernetes.

country.description: ISO country code, for the flag (`GB`).

method.cloudnodes.output.SizeList.description:
`cloud_sizes`: the sizes of one provider (and region), priced live from the provider's API
on every call (no cache, no price list in the app).

error.description: Why they did not (no credential, the API failed); `None` when priced or not priceable.

priced.description: The prices came from the provider just now.

method.cloudnodes.output.SizeOption.description: One size a provider offers for a node.

monthly_usd.description: Server only; `None` for Kubernetes (the cluster's cost).

method.cloudnodes.output.Stage.description: The create job's stages, in order (wizard step ④).

oneOf.description: Server (Droplet / Machine / Deployment) created and running.
Installing the newest signed theuth release (ends when the node dials the mesh).
The node presented its ticket; waiting until it is reachable.

method.cloudnodes.output.TerminalOpen.description: `cloud_terminal`: a PTY job on the node's engine; attach with `subscribe_pty(session, job)`.

engine.description: The node's mesh endpoint id (where the PTY runs).

session.description: The owner root session the PTY job belongs to, on the node.

method.cloudnodes.receiver.CloudList.description:
`cloud_list`: every node from local records and every connected provider's tagged
resources; a provider that fails is reported in `errors`, not fatal.

errors.description: Providers that could not be listed.

method.cloudnodes.receiver.CloudNode.description: One cloud node (a row in Settings › Machines).

auto_update.description: Follows stable releases (always true for nodes this builds).

created_ms.description: When this engine created it (Unix ms).

error.description: Why the create job or the last operation failed.

ip.description: Public IPv4 (no port is open on it).

monthly_usd.description:
Server + disk per month from the provider's live prices (a kept disk alone); `None` when
unknown, and always in events.

peer_id.description: Its mesh endpoint id once joined.

version.description: `t --version` on the node, when it answered.

method.cloudnodes.receiver.CredentialSou.description: Where the credential the engine would use comes from.

oneOf.description: `Sign in with DigitalOcean` (tokens from the relay's code exchange; refreshable).
Copied from a discovered CLI login on the user's press.
Kubernetes: kubectl and the user's kubeconfig (nothing stored).

method.cloudnodes.receiver.DesktopOpen.description:
`cloud_desktop`: a noVNC endpoint on this engine that tunnels over the mesh to the node's
loopback websockify, and its password. An owner-only RPC answer, never in an event (as
`sandbox_desktop_access`).

method.cloudnodes.receiver.Discovered.description:
A credential found on this machine (read-only discovery; nothing is copied until the user
presses "Use it" → `cloud_import_credential`). Never carries the secret itself.

detail.description: More: `context "default"`, `org personal`, `3 contexts`.

id.description: Stable id to pass back to `cloud_import_credential` (`doctl:default`, `flyctl`, `kube:<context>`).

label.description: What the UI says: "doctl login", "flyctl login", "kubeconfig context rwx-dev".

path.description: The file it was read from (`~/.config/doctl/config.yaml`).

method.cloudnodes.receiver.K8sInfo.description: `cloud_k8s_info`: what the Kubernetes variant of step 2 needs.

cni.description: The CNI detected from kube-system pods/daemonsets (`flannel`, `calico`, `cilium`, …).

enforces_network_policy.description: `false` for a CNI known not to enforce NetworkPolicy (flannel); `None` when unknown.

namespaces.description: Namespaces in the chosen context (empty when the user may not list them).

no_default_class.description: No class is marked default (a PVC without a class stays Pending).

context.description: kubeconfig context (default: the current one).

create_namespace.description: Create `namespace` when it does not exist.

deny_cluster_network.description: Add a NetworkPolicy: no ingress; egress to DNS and the internet, not the cluster.

storage_class.description: StorageClass of the volumes (default: the cluster's default).

oneOf.description: A direct connection (the node keeps its public IPv4 for this).

method.cloudnodes.receiver.NodeLogs.description: `cloud_logs`: the tail of the node engine's own log, read over the mesh.

lines.description: Oldest first, redacted by the node.

oneOf.description: The create job stopped (see `error`); destroy cleans up.
A restart / resize / update is in progress.

Found at the provider by its tags, with no record on this engine (made elsewhere, or the
record was lost). Destroy works on it.
Destroyed with its disk kept (provider still bills the disk).

method.cloudnodes.receiver.OauthStart.description:
`cloud_oauth_start`: open `url` in the system browser; completion arrives as
[`CloudEvent::CloudCredentialChanged`].

url.description: theuth-relay's start URL (no secret in it).

method.cloudnodes.receiver.ProviderInfo.description: One provider as the wizard shows it.

available.description: Can create nodes in this build (Lightsail: false).

connected.description: A usable credential is in the vault (or, for Kubernetes, kubectl has contexts).

desktop_only.description: Only offered where kubectl runs (desktop engines).

discovered.description: Credentials found on this machine, offered first on desktop.

oauth.description: "Sign in with DigitalOcean" works (the relay is reachable and this provider has OAuth).

source.description: Where the stored credential came from.

volume_usd_per_gb.description: Disk price per GB-month (`None` for Kubernetes).

oneOf.description: Droplet + Block Storage volume + Cloud Firewall; native install under systemd.
App + Volume + Machine (Machines API); the engine image. Beta: never live-tested.
A one-replica Deployment via kubectl (`sandbox::k8s`). Desktop only.
Lightsail instance + disk. Coming soon: listed, not creatable.

method.codeindex.input.LocateAnchor.description:
One board anchor (71 §2.3): a root-relative path with an optional 1-based
inclusive line range, the definition name the range quotes, and the
SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the quoted text.

symbol.description: Name of the `Definition` the range quotes; enables `moved`.

text_sha.description:
`sha256(text)` of the quoted lines joined by `\n`, no trailing newline;
absent = a bare link (the range only has to exist).

method.codeindex.input.SessionId.description: Identifies a conversation; every event carries one.

method.codeindex.output.ChangeFile.description: One file of a Change band.

test_link.description: Tests band: `ref` (names a changed symbol) or `subject` (name-derived).

via.description: Direct band: changed names it references, or `<import>`.

ambiguous_skipped.description: Same-name references that could not be attributed.

unindexed.description: Changed paths the index does not know.

unresolved_imports.description: Unresolved imports of the changed files.

state.description: Semantic state of the arrow; default default.

id.description: Unique within the graph; referenced by `GraphNode.group`.

method.document.input.DocId.description:
A document id: 26 lowercase base32 characters (§4.1). Bound documents (knowledge, artifact,
meeting note) render uuid v5 of the binding key under [`DocId::NAMESPACE`], so every engine of a
mesh mints the same id for the same thing (69 §5); notes, which have no natural key, render uuid v7.

oneOf.description: A knowledge concept; the derived file is `knowledge/<id>.md` and the first block is the frontmatter.
An agent's charter — the body of `agents/<name>.md` (67 §6.1); the roster copies each export into the file.

A task's thread (67 §7.1): comments, answers and the event log of one task. Owned by the task,
so it never lists as a note.

A board (71 §2.1): a note the agent draws for a reader — sections, anchored prose, `Excerpt`s and
diagrams — bound like a note (`Binding::Note`, `documents/<id>/note.md`); its first block is the

method.dreaming.input.TierA.description: Tier A: in-process, deterministic, every 25 labels or nightly.

Tier B: the LoRA adapter, data-triggered, gate-promoted. Revision 2: node-first; the local
path is behind `local` (default off) and aborts on owner activity.

batch.description:
Rows per optimiser step (the effective batch; the micro-batch is 2 × 256, the measured
memory ceiling — `train_b::TrainConfig`).

epochs.description: Passes over the corpus per run.

local.description:
Allow Tier B on this machine (inside the window, on AC, idle, holding a build slot,
aborting within one step on keyboard / mouse activity). Off: a mesh GPU node or nothing.

lr.description: Learning rate (1e-4 was the stable value at 2 × 256; 1e-3 diverged).

idle_min.description: User idle required before a run starts or resumes.

run_cap_min.description: Cumulative `running` minutes per night per run.

share_data.description: Ship scrubbed bundles to the owner's own GPU nodes (never a `Vm`).

window.description: Local hours Tier B may run, `HH:MM-HH:MM`.

method.dreaming.input.Triggers.description:
When Tier B becomes eligible (§7.3): whichever comes first. Tier A runs
every 25 labels or nightly regardless.

days.description: Days since the active version was trained.

labels.description: New labels since the active version's `data_range` end.

untidied.description: Entries never tidied (fresh or over-long titles).

method.dreaming.output.Caps.description: Max rung by risk (§9 caps). `mutating` may reach 3 only with the per-class opt-in.

destructive.description: Always 1: destructive never climbs past L1 (§0 item 4).

mutating.description: Mutating approvals; 3 only with the per-class opt-in.

read_only.description: 2 in the first release: L3 stays behind this cap (Revision 1 ruling 4).

method.dreaming.output.Capture.description: Which card kinds double predicts and learns from (§6.2).

method.dreaming.output.CardKind.description: What kind of card a class keys (126 §2 "decision card").

oneOf.description: A tool-call approval raised by the registry.
An attention-inbox item that is not an approval or ask (104).
A task / agent / routine draft card set.

method.dreaming.output.CurvePoint.description: One point of the learning curve (§7.4): a week, current vs baseline.

baseline.description: The frozen zero-shot oracle on the same rows.

week.description: RFC 3339 date of the week's Monday.

method.dreaming.output.DoubleClass.description: One row of `double_classes` (§13): the `classes` table plus its last-30-days numbers.

cap.description: Max rung for this class (§9 caps).

cap_reason.description: Why the cap holds, when it is below the ladder's next rung (`mutating — opt in to allow L2`).

median_answer_ms.description: Owner's median time-to-answer for this class.

mutating_opt_in.description: Per-class opt-in for L2 on a mutating class.

promote_hint.description: What one more correct answer would do ("12 more correct in a row").

capture.description: Which card kinds are predicted and learned from.

enabled.description: `false` (default): no actor, no tools, no prompt paragraph. Restart to change.

model.description: Restart to change.

retention_days.description:
`examples` / `labels` / `predictions` older than this are deleted,
except golden rows and the last 1,000 per class (§5).

method.dreaming.output.DoubleExample.description: One scrubbed example as the UI shows it (`double_class`, the popover).

card_excerpt.description: ≤ 160 chars of the scrubbed card text.

chose.description: What the owner chose (the direct / override label), when labelled.

options.description: Option labels in card order.

outcome.description: How the active version's prediction scored.

path.description: Absolute path of the scrubbed JSONL + embeddings archive.

active_version.description: `versions.id` of the active version; `None` before the first Tier A run (= baseline only).

approvals_off_sessions.description: Sessions with approvals off (§6.6): double learns only from asks there.

baseline.description: The same rows scored by the frozen zero-shot baseline.

next_window.description: RFC 3339 start of the next Tier B window.

paused.description: Learning paused: predictions and rungs continue, labels stop accruing.

method.dreaming.output.DreamModels.description: The four model tiers as the UI shows them (136 §2.7).

efforts.description:
194: `dreaming.efforts` — each tier's effort beside its pick in
`models`; cleared with it, dropped when a new pick does not take it.

resolved.description:
The models that actually run each tier tonight (136 D12): the config's
pick, else the server-side default. The UI shows these instead of
computing defaults client-side. Ignored on `set_settings`.

next_window.description: RFC 3339 of the next window start.

runs_on.description:
185 A5: where Dream now runs when it is not here — the hub's machine
name when this engine is peered, not the hub, and the hub is
connected (the press is forwarded); `None` = here.

method.dreaming.output.FamilyStats.description: What `Stats { family }` answers: today's file folded for one family.

accepted.description: Rows whose (inner) disposition was accept: the coverage numerator in shadow, the saved turns in active.

agreement.description: `confirmed / (confirmed + corrected)` over accepted rows with an outcome; the shadow agreement rate.

mode.description: The gate's mode right now (filled by the engine, not the fold).

tier2.description: Tier-2 rows (cheap-model answers) among `asks`, and how many of them were valid picks.

method.dreaming.output.Kpis.description: The §7.4 numbers for one version over one window, overall or per class.

brier.description: Mean squared error of `probs` against the one-hot label.

coverage_2pct.description: Share of decisions answerable at ≤ 2 % error with the current gate.

ece.description: Expected calibration error over 10 bins of `p_top`.

minutes_saved.description: Σ median_answer_ms over acted rows + 30 s interruption cost each.

n.description: Labelled prediction rows the numbers are over.

undo_rate_per_100.description: Undos during grace per 100 acted rows.

grace_secs.description: L2 countdown; 30 s (Revision 1 ruling 3). Clamped to `deadline − 2 s`.

method.dreaming.output.LoadedInfo.description: One resident checkpoint, for `decision_loaded` and the Settings line.

since_secs.description: Seconds since the session was installed.

active_concepts.description: Live concepts (`hint: true`, status fresh | tidy).

impressions_never_opened_share.description: Share of impressions on ids never opened.

preference_lines.description: Lines in the standing preferences block.

repeat_correction_rate.description: Cases of one intent reopened after a closing edit ÷ closed cases.

spend_usd.description: Money spent by dreaming in the window.

undos.description: Nights or groups undone in the window.

method.dreaming.output.Mode.description: `shadow`: compute, log, return `Shadow(inner)`; `active`: the verdict stands; `off`: never run.

oneOf.description: Run and log; the caller proceeds as today.

method.dreaming.output.ModeInfo.description:
What `GetMode { prefix }` answers (57 §3.4): the switch position for the families under a
prefix (`meeting` → `meeting.kind` + `meeting.brief` + `meeting.subject`) and what
effectively runs — `off` with a `reason` when the plugin is disabled or the checkpoint is
not on disk.

budget_ms.description: Tier-1 budget of the first family under the prefix, ms.

effective.description: What runs on the next ask.

installed.description: The prefix's checkpoint files are on disk.

mode.description: The configured mode (the most permissive one when the families disagree).

adapter_rank.description: LoRA rank of Tier B adapters.

method.dreaming.output.NightSummary.description: One night as the UI lists it (136 §2.7).

judge_same_model.description: The judge ran on the proposer's model (no `agent.escalate_model`, 136 D12).

undone.description: Every group of the night was undone.

method.dreaming.output.Outcome.description: How a prediction scored once the label arrived; also `predictions.outcome`.

method.dreaming.output.Proposal.description: One row for the attention inbox (136 §2.7).

body.description: The evidence and the cost of being wrong.

options.description: The option labels, in the user's words.

title.description: Line one: the thing to say back.

oneOf.description: An always-approved confirmation → a double class / policy change.

method.dreaming.output.ResolvedModels.description: What runs each tier (136 D12): `provider/model` strings, never `None`.

judge.description: Config `judge`, else `agent.escalate_model` when set and ≠ `propose`, else `propose`.

propose.description: v1 = `tidy` (the proposer runs in the night's own turn).

method.dreaming.output.RunId.description: One training run's id (`runs.id`), the reply of `double_train`.

oneOf.description: No run; the trigger has not fired.
Trigger met, preconditions not yet checked.
Taking the venue and the build slot.
A precondition broke mid-run; checkpointed at a step boundary.

A node deleted its bundle and checkpoints (§8.4).

method.link.input.DocId.description:
A document id: 26 lowercase base32 characters (§4.1). Bound documents (knowledge, artifact,
meeting note) render uuid v5 of the binding key under [`DocId::NAMESPACE`], so every engine of a
mesh mints the same id for the same thing (69 §5); notes, which have no natural key, render uuid v7.

method.link.input.Role.description: A member's capability (§8.1): `editor` (open, update, awareness, rename self) or `viewer` (open, awareness).

method.link.output.EngineId.description: An engine's identity: its iroh endpoint id (an Ed25519 public key) as text.

`meeting.effort` goes with `meeting.model`. `None` = `agent.effort`.

source.description: 158 §15.1 (W1): how the start happened; `None` = manual. Carried, not yet read.

template.description: 158 §11.1 (W4): the note template slug; `None` = remembered per event/project, else `meeting.template`.

title.description: Optional title; the session is named `Meeting <yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm>` regardless.

eventkit.description: Accept EventKit pushes from the macOS companion (§7.2).

method.meeting.output.CaptureFault.description: 173: why a capture track went quiet (the capture watchdog's episode reason).

oneOf.description:
Exact digital zeros for 15 s while sound played: a concurrent global-tap probe heard it
(per-app tap), or the source ran output (global tap, or a probe that could not open).
The OS refused the capture (System Audio Recording / Microphone permission).
The stream ended with an error (device lost, terminal error, reopen failed).

method.meeting.output.CaptureHealth.description:
173: one capture track as the user should hear about it. A track is `Ok` until the first
automatic reopen failed to bring audio back (or at once for a permission / terminal error),
so genuine silence never raises it. `since`: RFC 3339, when the track went quiet.

oneOf.description: Reopening; the first reopen did not help.
Three reopens did not help, or the OS refused: still retrying, the user should check.

reason.description: Why the app's tap was given up.

oneOf.description:
No echo cancellation on the mic: the VoiceProcessingIO unit could not be opened (macOS), or
the OS has none (Windows/Linux — 58 §6.1's normal case). Headphones recommended (53 §0.4).
Live transcription of one track stopped (phase 2).
The meeting session's model is failing (phase 2).
Under 500 MB free on the data volume.
Documents run but refused the meeting's note (59 §7.4; the documents helper missing): no note, no summary note.

Live speaker labels stopped (07 §6): the diariser's session failed or its task
panicked; system lines are `them:` from here, the post pass still diarizes.

173: the app's tap stayed silent through three reopens while sound played (a probe
heard it, or the app ran output); the system track recorded every app on the default
output (minus theuth) from `at_ms`, until a return probe found the app's tap live again
at `until_ms` (`None`: to the end).

reason.description: Why the app's tap was given up.

until_ms.description: Recording-clock end, once the app's tap came back.

enabled.description: Run the mic sensor and the rules engine at all.

ignore.description:
App ids (§4.3: bundle id on macOS, image name on Windows, `application.name` on Linux)
that never prompt. "Never for <App>" appends here.

poll_secs.description: Sensor tick in seconds (§4.2: 2, 5 on Linux).

The current prompt (§4.5 `Detected`, §15.1): what `meeting_detection` returns and what
`Status.detection` carries so a companion connecting mid-prompt can render it.

also.description: Other eligible holders at the same time (§4.4 rule 4).

brief.description: The cached pre-meeting brief bullets, once W3 fills it.

event.description: The calendar match, once W2 fills it.

project.description: The remembered or default project, once W3 fills it.

method.meeting.output.DocId.description:
A document id: 26 lowercase base32 characters (§4.1). Bound documents (knowledge, artifact,
meeting note) render uuid v5 of the binding key under [`DocId::NAMESPACE`], so every engine of a
mesh mints the same id for the same thing (69 §5); notes, which have no natural key, render uuid v7.

available_ms.description: Speech in the chosen segments before the cap.

speech_ms.description: Speech used for the voiceprint (<= 30 s).

transcript.description: The transcript after linking (label.profile/name set, proposed refreshed); unchanged when not linked.

method.meeting.output.EventMatch.description:
The matcher's answer for one detection (§8.1): the shown event, its score, the rest of the
window ordered by score for the `[▾]` list.

alternatives.description: Other candidates in the window, best first.

score.description: Its §8.1 score.

method.meeting.output.EventRef.description:
The event a meeting is tied to, persisted in the manifest because the calendar row
rotates out of the window (§8.3).

join_host.description: Its host (`zoom.us`, `meet.google.com`, …) for the §8.1 host term.

join_url.description: First meeting link in location/description/conference fields.

method.meeting.output.Gap.description:
A pause: `dur_ms` of wall time missing from the recording clock at `at_ms`. 173: with
`track` set, a capture gap instead — the clock ran but `track` was silence-padded from
`at_ms` for `dur_ms` (the watchdog's episode, `reason`; `retarget`: the pid the tap moved to).

retarget.description: 173: the same-bundle pid the system tap moved to during the gap.

track.description: 173: the silence-padded track of a capture gap; `None` for a pause.

consent_at.description: When the consent box was ticked (53 §0.14); RFC 3339.

context.description: User-given context (phase 2 sends it to the session).

event.description: 158 §8.3 (W2): the matched calendar event, persisted because the calendar row rotates out.

memory.description: 137 R1-D6: the session's memory mode (`epochs` for meetings recorded before it).

note.description: The meeting's note (59 §7.4), created at start; `None` for meetings recorded before notes existed.

project.description: 158 §9.2 (W3): the meeting's project; `None` = the `meetings` label as before.

stats.description: 158 §13 (W6): the echo counter from the post pass.

template.description: 158 §11.1 (W4): the note template slug; `meeting` reproduces today's headings.

project.description: `meeting.project`.

Threads joining, last pages being written.

project.description: 158 §9.2 (W3): the meeting's project (`meetings.project`).

137: the summary tree and its view.

method.meeting.output.ModeInfo.description:
What `GetMode { prefix }` answers (57 §3.4): the switch position for the families under a
prefix (`meeting` → `meeting.kind` + `meeting.brief` + `meeting.subject`) and what

method.meeting.receiver.CaptureFault.description: 173: why a capture track went quiet (the capture watchdog's episode reason).

oneOf.description:
Exact digital zeros for 15 s while sound played: a concurrent global-tap probe heard it
(per-app tap), or the source ran output (global tap, or a probe that could not open).
The OS refused the capture (System Audio Recording / Microphone permission).
The stream ended with an error (device lost, terminal error, reopen failed).

method.meeting.receiver.CaptureHealth.description:
173: one capture track as the user should hear about it. A track is `Ok` until the first
automatic reopen failed to bring audio back (or at once for a permission / terminal error),
so genuine silence never raises it. `since`: RFC 3339, when the track went quiet.

oneOf.description: Reopening; the first reopen did not help.
Three reopens did not help, or the OS refused: still retrying, the user should check.

reason.description: Why the app's tap was given up.

oneOf.description:
No echo cancellation on the mic: the VoiceProcessingIO unit could not be opened (macOS), or
the OS has none (Windows/Linux — 58 §6.1's normal case). Headphones recommended (53 §0.4).
Live transcription of one track stopped (phase 2).
The meeting session's model is failing (phase 2).
Under 500 MB free on the data volume.
Documents run but refused the meeting's note (59 §7.4; the documents helper missing): no note, no summary note.

Live speaker labels stopped (07 §6): the diariser's session failed or its task
panicked; system lines are `them:` from here, the post pass still diarizes.

173: the app's tap stayed silent through three reopens while sound played (a probe
heard it, or the app ran output); the system track recorded every app on the default
output (minus theuth) from `at_ms`, until a return probe found the app's tap live again
at `until_ms` (`None`: to the end).

reason.description: Why the app's tap was given up.

until_ms.description: Recording-clock end, once the app's tap came back.

enabled.description: Run the mic sensor and the rules engine at all.

not a protocol message.

id.description: First 8 chars of `base64url(static pub)`; stable, shown in the UI.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix ms of the last connection close; `0` while never seen.

online.description: A session conn is open right now.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix ms of the last session close; `0` while never seen.

revoked.description: `revoked_ms` is set: refused by every hub.

oneOf.description: Always on, no battery, no sleep.
Container on a server (as `Server` for the score, but marked).

accelerator.description:

engine older than this field. Optional on the wire so older engines
deserialise newer rows and vice versa.

availability_30d.description: Fraction of the last 30 days peers saw it reachable, 0..=1.

gpu.description:
Has a usable GPU. `true` on every Apple-silicon Mac and any Linux box
with a render node — not a training-grade signal; see `accelerator`.

host.description: Hostname, distinct from the mesh name; `""` from an older engine.

os_name.description: Display OS (`macOS`, `Arch Linux`, `Ubuntu`, `Windows`); `""` from an older engine.

method.nodes.output.HubPref.description: How willing an engine is to hold the hub lease (67 §4.5, decision 5).

method.nodes.output.KeyInfo.description:

the legacy key is `(0, "")`.

initiator.description: The engine that minted it; `""` for the legacy key.

members.description: Engines it was minted for or granted to (W-34).

minted_ms.description: When it was minted (ms since epoch; 0 for the legacy key).

holder.description: The hub; `None` while no engine qualifies or during a handover.

connected.description: The uplink is registered with the relay.

harness_id.description:
`base64url(static pub)`, 43 chars; `None` until an identity exists.
The engine's link id (historically 'harness'); the field name is kept for wire compatibility.

mesh.description: The mesh identity (69): `None` until the mesh device key was loaded.

method.nodes.output.MeshLink.description: The mesh identity's uplink (69 §3): what this engine serves as the hub.

connected.description: This engine holds the lease and its mesh uplink is registered.

device_id.description: `base64url(mesh static pub)`, 43 chars — what devices dial (`/h/<device_id>`).

docs_homes_on.description:
184 §10.4: this engine's `homes_on` (from `DocsGate`): notes have homes in this mesh; the
note's Move to ▸ item reads it. `false` from a pre-184 engine.

mesh_name.description:
The mesh's name (`mesh_meta.name`, 69 decision 8); `None` until an
engine wrote it.

messaging_off.description:
183 §6.2 (W-14): `mesh.messaging_off`, the machines this engine refuses agent messages
with (Settings › Network "Agents can message" off).

nearby.description: 183 §6.8: `mesh.nearby` (the "Let nearby machines find this one while pairing" switch).

peers.description: Every paired engine, this one excluded.

quarantined.description:
183 R1 (S1): machines an unpaired machine introduced after its unpair, not paired here
until a user confirms (`mesh_confirm_peer`).

relay.description: 183 §6.7: this engine's relay; `None` with `mesh.relay: none` or from an older engine.

replica.description: Replication counters; `None` until the replica plugin syncs over this mesh.

self_name.description: This engine's display name (`mesh.name`, default the hostname).

traffic.description: Per stream ALPN, what moved since start; sorted by `alpn`.

method.nodes.output.NearbyEngine.description: 183 §6.8: an engine found by the Nearby mDNS browse, not paired.

addr.description: The address it was seen at.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix ms of the last control-conn close; `0` never.

platform.description: Host OS as `info` reports it; `""` until the first connect.

relay.description: `ws(s)://host[:port]` of the relay the node registers at.

revoked.description: The node deleted us from its `devices.yaml` (32 §6.3).

version.description: `theuth` version as `info` reports it; `""` until the first connect.

method.nodes.output.PairCeremony.description: 183 §6.8: one Nearby pairing ceremony, as both sides show it.

addr.description:

address (acceptor); `""` when unknown. A contact ceremony (§7.4): the contact's
machine, from its card.

expires_ms.description: When the ceremony expires (ms since epoch).

method.nodes.output.Pairing.description: A pending pairing: the string the QR encodes (31 §4.4) and when it dies.

method.nodes.output.PairingPayload.description: `device_pair_start` reply (69 decision 4): what the QR encodes.

expires_ms.description: Unix ms; the `pending` row dies then (5 min).

addrs.description: Last known direct/relay addresses, as iroh prints them.

path.description: 183 §6.7: how it is reached now; `offline` from an older engine.

reachable.description: A connection is up right now.

rtt_ms.description: 183 §6.7: round-trip time of the live connection, when known.

method.nodes.output.PeerPath.description: 183 §3.3: how a peer is reached right now.

method.nodes.output.QuarantinedPeer.description: 183 R1 (S1), R4: a peer row a since-unpaired engine introduced, held back on this engine until confirmed.

added_by.description: The unpaired engine that introduced it.

connected.description: The endpoint holds a relay connection.

error.description: Why it is not connected, if known.

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip time to the relay, when known.

oneOf.description: The new key is being minted and stored.

([`Vault::finish_device_reset`]).

removed_names.description:
183 R2: the removed machines' names, in `removed` order ("a removed machine" when none
was known): what the UI shows, never an engine id.

rows_done.description: Rows already under the new key.

rows_stuck.description: Secret names whose rows open under no held key (§13 row 41).

sweep_hold_until_ms.description: 183 R4: the sweep hold's end (ms; [`Vault::rotate`]), kept so a restart still holds.

method.nodes.output.Stats.description:
Replication counters (69 audit): every path that could echo or storm has a
number that would show it; `mesh_status.replica` reports them. All but
`outbox_rows` count column changes since start.

echo.description:
Captured within 500 ms of an apply of the same `(table, pk, column, value)`.
Rising = a plugin writes back what replication just wrote.

outbox_rows.description: Batches held (own and relayed) after pruning.

relayed.description: Sent on a stream on behalf of another origin.

method.nodes.receiver.Accelerator.description:
The training-grade accelerator an engine advertises (126 §8.4), detected
the cheap way: Apple silicon → `metal`; `/dev/nvidia0` → `cuda`; else
`cpu` (a probed machine with no training-grade GPU — an Intel iGPU still
says `gpu = true`). Spelled like `models.accelerator`.

oneOf.description: An NVIDIA device (`/dev/nvidia0`; candle CUDA with the `decision/cuda` build).

method.nodes.receiver.AlpnTraffic.description:
Frames and bytes one stream ALPN has moved since start (69 audit: the
number a storm would show). A frame is one read or write on a stream,
not a protocol message.

method.nodes.receiver.Device.description: A paired device as the UIs list it.

id.description: First 8 chars of `base64url(static pub)`; stable, shown in the UI.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix ms of the last connection close; `0` while never seen.

online.description: A session conn is open right now.

method.nodes.receiver.DeviceInfo.description:
One row of the replicated device registry (69 §3), revoked rows included
— `devices_list`.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix ms of the last session close; `0` while never seen.

revoked.description: `revoked_ms` is set: refused by every hub.

method.nodes.receiver.EngineClass.description: What kind of machine an engine runs on; feeds the stability score.

oneOf.description: Always on, no battery, no sleep.
Container on a server (as `Server` for the score, but marked).
A VM on another engine's machine (79); ranks with Laptop.

method.nodes.receiver.EngineId.description: An engine's identity: its iroh endpoint id (an Ed25519 public key) as text.

method.nodes.receiver.EngineStats.description: What an engine advertises (67 §8 placement, §4.5 election).

accelerator.description:
Which training-grade accelerator the GPU is (126 §8.4); `None` from an
engine older than this field. Optional on the wire so older engines
deserialise newer rows and vice versa.

availability_30d.description: Fraction of the last 30 days peers saw it reachable, 0..=1.

gpu.description:
Has a usable GPU. `true` on every Apple-silicon Mac and any Linux box
with a render node — not a training-grade signal; see `accelerator`.

host.description: Hostname, distinct from the mesh name; `""` from an older engine.

os_name.description: Display OS (`macOS`, `Arch Linux`, `Ubuntu`, `Windows`); `""` from an older engine.

method.nodes.receiver.HubPref.description: How willing an engine is to hold the hub lease (67 §4.5, decision 5).

method.nodes.receiver.KeyInfo.description:
183 §14.7 (D7): one mesh key's identity and order. Keys order by `(epoch, initiator)`;
the legacy key is `(0, "")`.

initiator.description: The engine that minted it; `""` for the legacy key.

members.description: Engines it was minted for or granted to (W-34).

minted_ms.description: When it was minted (ms since epoch; 0 for the legacy key).

holder.description: The hub; `None` while no engine qualifies or during a handover.

connected.description: The uplink is registered with the relay.

harness_id.description:
`base64url(static pub)`, 43 chars; `None` until an identity exists.
The engine's link id (historically 'harness'); the field name is kept for wire compatibility.

mesh.description: The mesh identity (69): `None` until the mesh device key was loaded.

method.nodes.receiver.MeshLink.description: The mesh identity's uplink (69 §3): what this engine serves as the hub.

connected.description: This engine holds the lease and its mesh uplink is registered.

device_id.description: `base64url(mesh static pub)`, 43 chars — what devices dial (`/h/<device_id>`).

docs_homes_on.description:
184 §10.4: this engine's `homes_on` (from `DocsGate`): notes have homes in this mesh; the
note's Move to ▸ item reads it. `false` from a pre-184 engine.

mesh_name.description:
The mesh's name (`mesh_meta.name`, 69 decision 8); `None` until an
engine wrote it.

messaging_off.description:
183 §6.2 (W-14): `mesh.messaging_off`, the machines this engine refuses agent messages
with (Settings › Network "Agents can message" off).

nearby.description: 183 §6.8: `mesh.nearby` (the "Let nearby machines find this one while pairing" switch).

peers.description: Every paired engine, this one excluded.

quarantined.description:
183 R1 (S1): machines an unpaired machine introduced after its unpair, not paired here
until a user confirms (`mesh_confirm_peer`).

relay.description: 183 §6.7: this engine's relay; `None` with `mesh.relay: none` or from an older engine.

replica.description: Replication counters; `None` until the replica plugin syncs over this mesh.

self_name.description: This engine's display name (`mesh.name`, default the hostname).

traffic.description: Per stream ALPN, what moved since start; sorted by `alpn`.

method.nodes.receiver.NearbyEngine.description: 183 §6.8: an engine found by the Nearby mDNS browse, not paired.

addr.description: The address it was seen at.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix ms of the last control-conn close; `0` never.

platform.description: Host OS as `info` reports it; `""` until the first connect.

relay.description: `ws(s)://host[:port]` of the relay the node registers at.

revoked.description: The node deleted us from its `devices.yaml` (32 §6.3).

version.description: `theuth` version as `info` reports it; `""` until the first connect.

method.nodes.receiver.PairCeremony.description: 183 §6.8: one Nearby pairing ceremony, as both sides show it.

addr.description:
Where the other engine is: the advert's address (dialer) or the connection's remote
address (acceptor); `""` when unknown. A contact ceremony (§7.4): the contact's
machine, from its card.

expires_ms.description: When the ceremony expires (ms since epoch).

method.nodes.receiver.Pairing.description: A pending pairing: the string the QR encodes (31 §4.4) and when it dies.

method.nodes.receiver.PairingPayload.description: `device_pair_start` reply (69 decision 4): what the QR encodes.

expires_ms.description: Unix ms; the `pending` row dies then (5 min).

method.nodes.receiver.Peer.description: One row of the peer set (`peers` table) with live reachability.

addrs.description: Last known direct/relay addresses, as iroh prints them.

last_seen_ms.description: Last time this engine heard from it (ms since epoch; 0 = never).

path.description: 183 §6.7: how it is reached now; `offline` from an older engine.

reachable.description: A connection is up right now.

rtt_ms.description: 183 §6.7: round-trip time of the live connection, when known.

method.nodes.receiver.PeerPath.description: 183 §3.3: how a peer is reached right now.

method.nodes.receiver.QuarantinedPeer.description: 183 R1 (S1), R4: a peer row a since-unpaired engine introduced, held back on this engine until confirmed.

added_by.description: The unpaired engine that introduced it.

method.nodes.receiver.RelayState.description: 183 §6.7: this engine's relay as `mesh_status` reports it.

connected.description: The endpoint holds a relay connection.

error.description: Why it is not connected, if known.

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip time to the relay, when known.

method.nodes.receiver.RotationPeer.description: 183 §14.7: one remaining machine as the rotation sees it.

old_build.description: Connected 5 s without sending `KeyEpoch`: a pre-183 build (§6.9.10).

oneOf.description: The new key is being minted and stored.
Rows are being re-sealed under it.
Every local row is swept; waiting for offline machines and the retire grace.
Stopped; the old key stays current (`error`, Retry = `vault_rotate`).

method.nodes.receiver.RotationState.description:

`SecretsEvent::Rotation`). Names only, never values.

device_reset_pending.description:
183 R1: the unpair asked for a device-key reset that is not finished yet
([`Vault::finish_device_reset`]).

old_destroyed.description: The previous key is retired here.

removed.description: Engines whose unpair started it; empty for a manual rotation.

method.roster.input.AgentFile.description: `agents/<name>.md` parsed (67 §6.1): the front matter plus the charter body.

capabilities.description: "When I am relevant", read by other agents when handing off.

effort.description: Effort for every session it opens.

isolated_memory.description: Local, separate knowledge bundle (196); independent of context memory mode.

mcp.description:
MCP servers (or `server.tool`) it may see (67 §6.3): `None` = every
server, `Some([])` = none, `Some(list)` = only those.

memory.description:
137 D12 / §10: the memory mode of every desk session it opens;
`None` = `agent.endless.default_desk`.

memory_effort.description:
194: the effort of `memory_model` (`None` = thinking off); dropped
with `memory_model` and when a new one does not take it.

memory_model.description:
137G: the compactor model of its desk sessions (the chain's agent link,
below a chat's own pick); `None` = `agent.endless.model` → title → session.

model.description: Model for every session it opens.

proposed_by.description: `agent:<name>` when this file came from `agent_propose` and is not yet approved (67 §6.5).

reports_to.description: Manager: an agent name, or `theuth` (the default).

runs_in.description: Placement pin (79 decision 14): where every work session of this agent runs.

tail_high_bytes.description: 201 §4.2: per-agent fixed high mark in bytes (16_000..=512_000), above the low one.

tail_high_share.description: 201 §4.2: per-agent scaled high share (0.05..=0.60), above the low one.

tail_low_bytes.description: 201 §4.2: per-agent fixed low mark in bytes (8_000..=256_000).

title.description: Display title; defaults to the name.

view_bytes.description:
137 R1-D2: per-agent view budget in bytes (16_000..=256_000); `None` =
`agent.endless.view_bytes`.

method.roster.input.AgentName.description:
An agent name: `[a-z0-9-]{1,32}`. `theuth` is reserved for the built-in
default agent and is never a roster entry (67 §6.1).

method.roster.input.AttachRef.description:
One attached reference: `title`/`meta` are frozen at attach time and are
display text only; `meta` may be empty.

id.description: The id the read tool for `kind` accepts.

meta.description: Display-only facts (`pdf v2 · 3 pages`); may be empty.

title.description: Human name as the user saw it; never empty (a missing one is filled from the id by whoever renders).

method.roster.input.AttentionFilter.description: 207 §5.3: a filter over the current list. Every part that is set must match.

before_ms.description: Only items with `at_ms <= before_ms` (the newest the caller had seen); `None` = no bound.

kinds.description: Any of these kinds; empty = every kind.

projects.description: Any of these projects; `""` matches items without a project; empty = every project.

method.roster.input.AttentionKind.description: What kind of decision an item wants.

oneOf.description: A tool call waits for allow / deny.
A task is blocked on a `decision:<id>` — answer it.
A proposed agent waits for hire / decline.
A task is blocked on a person or another task.
A task in review with the user as reviewer — done or back.
An agent at ≥ 80 % of its month budget, or paused at the cap.
An agent in a VM needs a human at its desktop (79 §6.6): open it, then Done / Cancel.
A session asked for a secret (79 §6.6): the masked card, one or several fields.
A session asked the user a question (`ask_user`, 104 A1): answer or dismiss.
